jobs.title: Account Executive (Remote from Net)
jobs.description:
Account Executive (Remote from Net)

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Netherlands.

As an Account Executive – EMEA, you will drive new business development and strategic account growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, helping shape the future of AI-powered engineering and semiconductor design. You will introduce innovative physics simulation technology to leading semiconductor and electronics organizations, demonstrating its value in optimizing hardware development and manufacturing workflows. Combining new customer acquisition with strategic account expansion, you will build relationships with technical experts, business leaders, and C-level executives. You will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, develop regional partnerships, and create demand in an emerging technology market. Working closely with engineering, pre-sales, and product teams, you will ensure successful customer evaluations and long-term adoption. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to influence an evolving industry while taking ownership of a strategic international territory.


Accountabilities

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships within key enterprise accounts across EMEA, identifying business units and opportunities where advanced physics simulation technology can deliver measurable business value.

  • New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and develop new strategic customers, generating demand and establishing relationships with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

  • Account Expansion: Drive both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts, developing land-and-expand strategies across complex engineering organizations.

  • Partner Ecosystem Development: Build and manage relationships with resellers, service providers, distributors, and strategic channel partners to increase regional market reach, generate customer introductions, and accelerate adoption.

  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire enterprise sales process, from prospecting and discovery to value proposition development, technical evaluations, contract negotiations, and closing high-value deals.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with pre-sales, forward-deployment, and engineering teams to coordinate customer test cases and pilot deployments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Pipeline Management and Forecasting: Maintain a strong and accurate sales pipeline, targeting at least four times quota coverage while providing clear forecasts and visibility into opportunity progression.

  • Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather customer insights, partner feedback, regional market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform product development and commercial strategy.

  • Strategic Customer Engagement: Navigate complex organizational structures and engage effectively with technical individual contributors, domain experts, senior executives, and decision-makers.

  • Regional Market Development: Represent the business across EMEA, regularly traveling to strategic customer locations and partner organizations to develop relationships and advance commercial opportunities.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of experience in enterprise software sales, ideally as a major account manager or enterprise account executive within the semiconductor or electronics industry.

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual sales quotas of $2 million or more and closing complex, high-value deals ranging from six to seven figures.

  • Strong understanding of the semiconductor ecosystem, including Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, fabless and Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) business models, and advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D and 3D IC.

  • Established network of senior decision-makers and industry contacts within major semiconductor, electronics, or engineering organizations across EMEA.

  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and commercial value propositions to VP-level and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to discuss physics simulation concepts and their applications in design, validation, and manufacturing workflows without relying on sales engineers for every customer interaction.

  • Demonstrated experience selling through and managing partner ecosystems, including resellers, distributors, service providers, or other channel relationships.

  • Strong strategic account planning, prospecting, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Ability to operate autonomously, build relationships from the ground up, and create demand in markets where product categories and purchasing budgets may not yet be established.

  • Experience with consultative, challenger, and value-based selling methodologies, ideally supported by MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or Force Management frameworks.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, combined with a proactive, entrepreneurial, and results-driven mindset.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Academic or professional background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Previous Account Executive or enterprise sales experience at a leading EDA or engineering software company, such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Ansys.

  • Experience working for a high-growth AI or deep-tech startup focused on engineering applications.

  • Existing relationships with senior executives and decision-makers at major semiconductor companies across EMEA.

  • Proven success implementing land-and-expand strategies within large, complex, and highly specialized engineering organizations.

  • Experience establishing and scaling strategic channel and partner ecosystems.

  • Strong evangelistic selling skills, with the ability to educate customers, challenge established practices, and introduce innovative technology solutions.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to help define the future of AI-powered hardware design and engineering.

  • Ownership of commercial strategy and enterprise relationships with influential semiconductor organizations worldwide.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies at the intersection of artificial intelligence, physics simulation, and advanced engineering.

  • Opportunity to develop and lead a strategic international sales territory across EMEA.

  • Close collaboration with highly skilled engineers, researchers, and commercial professionals.

  • Dynamic, fast-paced startup environment offering significant autonomy and professional responsibility.

  • Opportunity to influence product direction, market positioning, and the development of an emerging technology category.

  • Career development potential within an innovative and rapidly growing technology business.

jobs.description:
Payment Operations Specialist (12-month Maternity Cover)

If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place.

Backed by General Catalyst, the investors behind companies like Stripe and Airbnb, we're building something extraordinary.

Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

  • Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes.

  • Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive.

And we're already making a difference:

  • $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022.

  • Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database.

  • 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week.

  • Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb, alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam.


What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems. That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as Payments Operations Specialist!

As a Payments Operations Specialist, you’ll play a vital role in ensuring the accurate, efficient, and timely flow of funds to charities worldwide. You will execute payment-related processes, support the team in meeting service level agreements (SLAs), resolve payment issues, and use AI and automation to make our processes smarter. This role gives you a unique opportunity to work with global currencies, learn about international payment systems, and directly contribute to enabling positive change on a global scale.

As Payment Operations Specialist, your mission will be to:

  • Execute daily tasks related to payment processing, ensuring all payments are made accurately and on time.

  • Process payments to charities via various methods, including bank transfers, cheques and card payments.

  • Identify opportunities to refine workflows for improved efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Use AI and automation tools (e.g., n8n or LLM-based workflows) to reduce manual effort in payment processes such as reconciliations, query triage and payment status updates, within our data protection and security standards.

  • Respond to customer and internal queries regarding payments, ensuring clear and timely communication.

  • Handle complex payment issues such as failed payments, undeliverable donations, and reassignments, escalating issues when necessary.

  • Monitor and track payment workflows, ensuring adherence to SLAs and KPIs.

  • Detect, escalate, and help resolve domain-related problems and operational challenges.

  • Follow operational procedures meticulously while keeping track of critical updates to ensure compliance and efficiency.

  • Collaborate with other teams, including GTM, Customer Service, Product, and Engineering, to improve payment processes and address challenges.

After 3 months, success will look like:

  • You have a strong understanding of the end-to-end payment processing workflow and key systems involved.

  • You’re executing daily tasks with accuracy and timeliness, consistently meeting SLA targets.

  • Complex payment issues are escalated and resolved efficiently, reducing recurring issues.

  • Customer queries are being addressed with clarity and empathy, contributing to high satisfaction levels.

  • You’ve identified and suggested improvements for at least one key process to enhance team efficiency.

  • You’ve identified at least one manual process that could be automated and have scoped or started building the solution.

This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience in payment operations, banking, financial services, or a similar role.

  • Hands-on experience building or using AI-powered automations to streamline operational or finance workflows.

  • A strong understanding of payment systems, international funds transfers, and currencies.

  • A process-driven mindset with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with domestic and international payment networks (e.g. Faster Payments, BACS, CHAPS, SEPA and SWIFT).

  • Proven ability to handle complex payment issues and provide clear, customer-centric resolutions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A metrics-oriented approach, with experience meeting SLAs and KPIs.

  • Proficiency in Google Sheets and comfort with payment and data analytics software.

Bonus if you have knowledge or love of:

  • Experience within the charity or non-profit sector or with social impact-oriented brands.

About us

Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. In this future, the depth and breadth of impact we can make through everyday actions will expand dramatically – benefiting both businesses and the world.

Businesses are expected to deliver on both profit and purpose and those that don’t are falling behind. We’re here to make it easy for any company, anywhere in the world, to integrate good into what they do. Doing this empowers everyone – companies, employees, consumers, and communities – to contribute to positive change and take meaningful action.

Let's do this! 💜

OUR PLEDGE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX

Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX

Location: Netherlands – regular travel within BENELUX

Start date: Q1 2027

Compensation: €65K - €85K base annually (depending on experience and location) +OTE

Employment type: Full-time

About DTACT

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

The Role

We're looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to make their mark in a brand-new role, with the rare chance to build a function rather than inherit one. As DTACT’s first BDM, you’ll grow our business across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg through system integrators and other integrator partners, shaping how the function is designed and scaled. You’ll be the primary commercial contact for a portfolio of partners, building relationships, agreeing joint business plans and turning partner activity into a steady flow of qualified pipeline and closed deals. Reporting to the Head of Sales BENELUX & South, you’ll work closely with Customer Experience, Product and Pre-sales to make every joint deal a success, with plenty of room to run your own agenda.

We’re looking for an enterprising, resourceful self-starter who treats every result as their own and flourishes with real independence. You’re a relationship builder with strong commercial drive who understands how integrators make money and how their sales and delivery teams work. You earn trust quickly with partner leaders and technical teams alike, you’re comfortable working across cultures and languages in BENELUX, and you pair a collaborative attitude with the discipline to hit your number. If you’d rather build something than step into something, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of BENELUX integrator partners and be their first point of contact at DTACT.

  • Build and execute joint business plans with clear targets for pipeline, revenue, enablement and customer wins.

  • Identify, qualify and recruit new integrator partners that fit DTACT's market and strategy.

  • Own and accurately forecast the partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue for your portfolio.

  • Co-sell with partners: join customer meetings, support proposals, build joint pipeline and drive complex deals to close, applying deal registration, pricing and margin rules consistently.

  • Make sure partner teams are trained, certified and confident; run regular business reviews; and work with Customer Experience on joint customer delivery.

  • Keep the CRM accurate, report on pipeline and partner performance, and bring partner feedback to Product, Engineering and Marketing.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of B2B sales or account management in IT, software or cybersecurity, focused on channel, partner or integrator sales.

  • A proven track record of meeting revenue targets through partners and building joint business plans.

  • An existing network or strong knowledge of system integrators and IT partners in BENELUX.

  • Enough technical understanding to hold credible conversations with partner engineers.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Proactive, hands on approach. Does not need close supervision.

  • Professional English and Dutch; German is a strong plus.

  • Nice to have: experience in cybersecurity, AI or data; building partner programs; or public-sector and tender sales.

What's in for you

  • Competitive compensation and equity participation, including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success.

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs.

  • A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication, empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams.

  • Generous time off, including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Home office support, including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace.

  • An international and diverse team, where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives.

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.

Combining architectural expertise with technical understanding, you will adapt product demonstrations to different customer needs and evaluate new features from a practical planning perspective. You will also manage relationships with strategic accounts, understand their workflows, and translate operational challenges into actionable product requirements. jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Revenue Operations Manager

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 

What Will You Be Doing?

Run Complex Modelling & Analysis

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

  • Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

  • Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable.

Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Grow Into Forecasting

  • Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.

Systems and Digital Solutions Intern

Title:                                       Systems and Digital Solutions Intern

Type of contract:                   Paid internship

Contract duration:                 6 months   

Work time:                             Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time

Reporting to:                         Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator

Technical guidance:              BI and Systems Officer

Location:                                Remote (home-based outside Switzerland)

Start date:                              January 2027

Application deadline:           10/12/2026

 

Background

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work.

 

Role Summary

The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements.

 

Position Responsibilities

Systems and User Support

  • Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day;

  • Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews;

  • Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases;

  • Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly.

Data Quality and Information Management

  • Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues;

  • Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance;

  • Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions;

  • Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions.

Documentation, Training and Continuity

  • Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials;

  • Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities;

  • Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates;

  • Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement.

 

Position Requirements

Education and Experience

The opportunity.

Want to help defence and national security organisations see the risk hidden in their supply chains, their suppliers, their people and the threats they track? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our National Security and Defence solutions. You'll build this sub-industry for Quantexa with the UK and allied defence and national security markets worldwide, set its direction and take it to market with our partners.

Defence ministries, armed forces, intelligence agencies and homeland security bodies hold supplier, personnel and intelligence data in separate, often classified systems. Hidden foreign ownership behind a supplier, a dual-use export, procurement fraud, a gap in a vetting record, a sanctions or proliferation network, or a sign of hostile state activity is easy to miss.

That's the problem we solve. We connect that data into resolved entities and networks – who owns, supplies, funds and works for whom – so analysts can see the connections that matter, across supply chain risk, personnel vetting, counter-proliferation and intelligence analysis.   • Bring the field back into Product – decide which field work becomes product, and work with R&D to keep the solution ahead.

  • A recognised voice in the market, with [n] customer or partner proof points we can use.

  • Field Engineering and our main partners able to sell and demo the National Security and Defence solutions without you.

What you'll bring.

You have deep expertise in defence or national security, ideally in supply chain risk, security vetting, counter-proliferation or intelligence analysis. Don't tick every box below? If you recognise yourself in most of it, we'd still like to hear from you.

  • Real depth in defence or national security. You have built or run supply chain risk, security vetting, counter-proliferation or intelligence analysis systems or strategies, inside a defence ministry, the armed forces, an intelligence or homeland security agency, at a prime or system integrator, or advising one. Credible with analysts. Credible with senior officers and officials.

  • Strategy, and sleeves rolled up. You'll set the direction – then happily build the business case, the demo or the deck yourself.

  • Curiosity about the tech. You'll learn our platform properly, so you can say what it does and where it's genuinely different.

  • You choose well where to spend your time, and bring colleagues, partners and clients with you.

  • Able to obtain and keep local security clearance (eg: UK: SC or DV).

Nice to have.

  • French, Dutch or German.

  • Experience of defence procurement, export controls, sanctions or counter-proliferation.

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Spark, Scala, Elastic or Python.

  • Experience across several international defence and national security markets, or extra languages.

Location.

This role is based in London, with regular international travel to customers, partners and our other offices.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Application Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Application Operations Engineer
Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people and vehicles using 3D LiDAR data.
Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction.
 
Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.
 
You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do :
Insights about Outsight
 
Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience.  We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.
Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.
 
 
Position Overview :
 
Outsight operates a Hybrid SaaS architecture and is shifting its operational focus from infrastructure-heavy systems support to application-level support. In this role, you maintain the daily stability of live customer deployments. You will isolate software incidents, parse application logs, and escalate verified product defects to the L2 Customer Engineering team. This position requires participating in a scheduled night and weekend on-call rotation.
 
What will be your responsibilities? 
 

  • Operational Handover: Validate that new customer deployments meet documentation, alert thresholds, and tracking metric standards before accepting operational ownership from Field Application Engineers (FAEs).

  • Technical Triaging: Triage incoming tickets, reproduce application defects in test environments, and escalate unresolved software issues to L2 engineering with targeted log data.

  • Production Operations: Execute scheduled configuration changes, system health audits, and remote software updates on live production environments.

  • Documentation: Write and maintain internal runbooks and technical troubleshooting guides to standardize incident resolution workflows.

  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Reconstruct incident timelines and extract log data to submit bug reports to Product and Engineering teams.

 
What are the requirements for the role? 
 

  • Experience: 3+ years supporting live production software environments within technical support, system administration, deployment engineering, or site reliability engineering (SRE).

  • Linux Skills: Direct experience with Linux/Unix command-line navigation, system administration utilities, log parsing, and remote diagnostics.

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Experience navigating hybrid environments combining physical hardware, TCP/IP networking (DNS, VPNs, firewalls, VLANs), and cloud services.

  • Incident Communication: Experience providing technical timelines and status updates to internal stakeholders during critical incidents.

  • Languages: Professional fluency in English. French language proficiency is an asset.

  • Flexibility: Availability to participate in a scheduled night and weekend on-call rotation.

  • Preferred Qualifications: Hands-on experience with Bash, Python, SQL, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana, or Prometheus. Background in IoT, edge computing, or computer vision environments.

 
Why join us?
 

Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows.

As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents.

Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics.

Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

The Senior Sales Compensation Analyst drives the day-to-day sales compensation operations for Jamf's global sales organization and serves as the technical and modeling lead for the team. The Senior Sales Compensation Analyst works closely with Finance, Sales Leadership, Sales Operations, Legal, and HR to design plans that motivate our sales teams, keep incentive cost predictable.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Own the monthly commission close and annual plan calendar, setting priorities across controls, CaptivateIQ updates, and model deadlines.

Design Engineer

Design Engineer

London, 5x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for a Design Engineer to join our product design and engineering team. You will design and develop the interfaces and interactions for asset managers to work with Vega agents. The role suits someone who has worked as both a product designer and a (front-end) engineer.


About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Design for people nobody has ever designed for. Operations teams at the world's largest asset managers run fragmented, inefficient processes on software built without care or context. Sit with them, watch them work, and turn what you see into flows that get the job done faster without weakening their controls.

  • Take features through VegaOS from sketch to production. You design the flow, build it, and merge it into main alongside our engineers. Your spike is UI/UX but you don’t need full-time developers to build and ship your vision when push comes to shove. When something looks or feels wrong anywhere in the product, you confidently open the PRs yourself.

  • Work in code from the first conversation with a PM so the team argues about something real, not a Figma frame.

  • Design and build for AI in the loop. Much of VegaOS is screens where an agent has done part of the work and a human has to check it. Make that fast, legible and reversible.

  • Own the design system: tokens, components, theming. Decide what goes in it, keep it consistent across the investor and asset manager portals, and make it easy for engineers to do the right thing by default.

What we look for

  • Real design experience and real shipping experience. Our rough guide is 4 years of product design and 2 years of production front-end, but evidence beats years: show us one thing you designed and built yourself that real users touch. Side projects and rough prototypes count but we are not looking for blind vibe prompting.

  • Fluent in React, TypeScript and Tailwind, and you build with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor every day, with the judgement to review, test and own what they produce – code consistency, not just smooth UI/UX. You take a feature from a blank frame to a merged PR without someone else in the loop.

  • You have designed and built dense, data-heavy B2B tools with AI in the workflow, and brought consumer-grade polish to enterprise-grade complexity.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large or very large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer

Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people and vehicles using 3D LiDAR data.

Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction.

 

Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.

 

You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do :

Insights about Outsight

 

Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience.  We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.

 

Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.

 

Context

 

We are seeking a senior systems thinker to anchor the data lifecycle of Outsight's spatial events. This individual will own the structural flow of high-volume event data processing from our internal Perception stack and 3rd-party datasets, translating them into well-modeled, hyper-performant warehouse layers and clean semantic models.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Design, construct, and maintain production-grade ELT pipelines processing streaming spatial data and telemetry.

  • Architect and manage schemas within Databricks and AWS environments, prioritizing zero-data-loss and ultra-low latency.

  • Build out and optimize the central semantic abstraction layer using Cube.js, ensuring clean data consumption contracts.

  • Collaborate with internal team to package reliable data pipeline integration blueprints for the Professional Services delivery squads.

Requirements for the role

Agentic Workflow & Productivity Edge: You must possess deep familiarity with structuring semantic layers specifically to be accurately browsed and mapped by LLM-driven agents. The ideal candidate actively utilizes advanced AI coding frameworks to multi-thread feature delivery and automate pipeline unit testing, achieving an outsized development cadence.

 

Why join us?

 

Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows.

 

As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents.

 

Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics.

 

Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

 

Outsight is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Outsighters don't make employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military status, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Outsight also strives for a healthy and safe workplace, and prohibits harassment of any kind. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior DevSecOps Engineer

Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time.

360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue.

We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for.

“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach.


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture

  • Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer

  • Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily

  • Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end


    • Within 3 months, you will:

  • Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end

  • Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production

  • Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up


    • Within 6 months, you will:

  • Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts

  • Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention

  • Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting


    • Within 12 months, you will:

  • Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks

  • Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope

  • Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about


    • The Skill Set:

  • 5+ years in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering with a strong security focus, or in security engineering with hands on infrastructure practice

  • Production experience with Kubernetes: RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, secrets handling, workload identity, runtime security

  • Solid cloud experience, ideally Azure. Strong AWS or Google Cloud experience with a genuine interest in converting works too

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines

  • Scripting and automation: Python or Go, plus shell. Comfortable reading and writing code, and opening pull requests on repositories owned by other teams

  • Log analysis and investigation: cloud audit logs, query languages, correlation across identity, network and application sources

  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR). 

  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L


    • What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈

  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 

  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍

  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆


    • Interview Process:
  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our Head of Security
  • Live exercise with our Head of Security and our Head of Devops: investigation of an incident scenario, or review of an insecure infrastructure configuration
  • Clarification Meeting with the Security Engineer and a DevOps engineer
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our VP of Engineering
  • Offer!
    • Who We Are
    360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

    360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

    Learning Includes Everyone.
    In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

Social & Creative Intern - Paper.io 2

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. 6-month internship in our Paris office, starting between January and March 2027.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Frontend Engineer

Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~3–5 years of relevant experience

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role

As Frontend Engineer you own the web applications people use to run our instrument and read its results: an operator console that configures and runs scans with live camera and stage data, and a reconstruction front-end for setting up runs and inspecting images. Your users are the engineers in our lab, so feedback is immediate. You work closely with the Embedded, Software and Algorithm engineers who build the systems behind your interfaces.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain the frontends of our acquisition and reconstruction applications, from design to release.

  • Develop real-time views of camera images, stage positions and scan progress streamed from the instrument.

  • Design clear, safe operator workflows for configuring and running measurements.

  • Keep a shared design system and component library across our applications.

  • Extend the Python and C# backends where a feature needs it, together with the backend owners.

  • Take part in code review and bring good frontend practice to the team: typing, testing, CI.

Your profile

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • ~3–5 years of experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.

  • Experience with real-time or data-heavy interfaces (WebSockets, streaming data, canvas or WebGL rendering).

  • Strong CSS and a feel for clean, usable interface design.

  • Working knowledge of Python or C# and REST APIs.

  • Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus

  • Experience building software for scientific instruments, industrial machines or other hardware.

  • Experience with image or scientific data visualization.

  • Experience with FastAPI or ASP.NET Core, end-to-end testing (Playwright, Cypress), or working in a Scrum team.

  • Interest in optics, imaging or semiconductor metrology.

Job Summary

We’re hiring Platform Backend Engineers to build and operate the core services connecting workflow execution, identity, event routing, secrets management, and audit capabilities across Kaseya’s platform. This is a hands-on backend role focused on Go or Rust, event-driven systems, multi-tenant security, and production reliability. You’ll build foundational services used by engineering teams and AI-enabled workflows, with correctness, auditability, and operational clarity as core design requirements.

  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, or fine-grained access controls
  • Experience implementing encryption or key-management solutions using cloud KMS platforms, envelope encryption, or key-hierarchy designs

  • Experience integrating MSP, PSA, RMM, security, or Microsoft 365 platform APIs
  • Experience building software for regulated environments subject to SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, or similar requirements
  • Experience developing multi-cloud platform services across AWS, Azure, or GCP

Senior Process & Equipment Engineer - SiN/Si PVD Deposition (f/m/d)

Your Role

As a Senior Process and Equipment Engineer - PVD, you will take ownership of advanced PVD and CVD deposition processes and equipment within FabONE.

You will develop and release Si and SiN PVD deposition processes, commission new process chambers and optimize thin-film properties such as refractive index, thickness uniformity, film stress and defect density. Working on site in our Aachen cleanroom, you will collaborate closely with other deposition team members, process Integration and other engineering teams to ensure that deposited films meet the electrical and optical requirements of our devices.

You will also be responsible for maintaining reliable equipment performance, troubleshooting complex hardware and process issues, and preparing the tools and processes for volume manufacturing.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop, optimize, qualify and release Si and SiN PVD deposition processes that meet defined optical and electrical requirements

  • Lead the installation, commissioning, acceptance testing and process qualification of new PVD process chambers

  • Optimize film properties, including refractive index, stoichiometry, stress, thickness and thickness uniformity

  • Reduce inline defect density and improve process repeatability, stability and yield

  • Use Design of Experiments, SPC and root-cause analysis to improve process and equipment performance

  • Establish SPC baselines and routine monitoring protocols for deposition processes and equipment

  • Troubleshoot vacuum, RF power, matching-network, magnetron-sputtering and gas-delivery systems

  • Develop preventive-maintenance and operation procedures and coordinate technical support with equipment vendors

  • Work closely with Process Integration engineers to align deposited films with electrooptical-device performance requirements

  • Create SOPs and process documentation

  • Train shift engineers and technicians on daily PVD tool operation, monitoring and troubleshooting

What You Bring

  • Extensive hands-on experience in PVD process and equipment engineering, including sputtering or impulse-deposition technologies

  • Strong experience developing, optimizing and releasing semiconductor deposition processes in a cleanroom fab environment

  • Expertise in controlling thin-film properties such as refractive index, stoichiometry, thickness uniformity, film stress and defect density

  • Experience with Si and SiN thin-film deposition and dielectric-layer optimization

  • A proven track record of installing, commissioning, accepting and qualifying new process tools or chambers

  • Strong hardware troubleshooting skills across vacuum systems, RF generators, matching networks, magnetron sputtering and gas-delivery subsystems

  • Experience using thin-film characterization techniques such as ellipsometry, XRF or comparable measurement systems

  • Proficiency in Statistical Process Control and Design of Experiments, including tools such as JMP or Minitab

  • Experience establishing preventive-maintenance routines and improving equipment uptime

  • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills for complex process and equipment issues

  • Confidence working with equipment vendors and coordinating technical activities across different engineering teams

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary environment

  • Comfortable working on site in a cleanroom environment while wearing the required PPE

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

At Omegga, we develop spectral intelligence: we combine AI and spectroscopy to make the invisible visible. WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

jobs.title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
jobs.description:
Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.
