jobs.description:
Marketing Operations

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

jobs.title: HTS Testing Engineer
jobs.description:
HTS Testing Engineer

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy.

  • Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale.

  • Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology.


    WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Qualification at Scale

  • Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory.

  • Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes.

  • Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design.

  • Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators.

2. R&D

  • HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities.

  • Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams.

  • Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners.

3. Planning, Safety & Team

  • Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme.

  • Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests.

  • Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields.

  • Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible.

WHO YOU ARE

An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale.

  • You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have hands-on experience characterising materials or devices, and are comfortable designing experiments.

  • You speak fluent English.

  • You have strong data analysis skills and a solid grasp of measurement uncertainty and statistics.

  • You are happy to travel for test campaigns at external facilities, including internationally.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with superconductors, cryogenics or high magnetic fields.

  • Experience with quality control or production testing at scale.

  • Experience designing cryogenic or automated test equipment.

  • Familiarity with HTS tape manufacturing processes and the supplier landscape.

  • German language skills.

This role will initially be based in our Zurich office. As the project develops, the position may move to Germany. If that happens, we’ll give you at least six months’ notice and support you through the move.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase


Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
jobs.description:
Inbound Sales 🇫🇷

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Senior SRE / Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) Senior SRE / Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d)

Mission

SimScale is a browser-based engineering simulation platform on AWS. Our infrastructure team builds and operates the shared cloud foundation that 40+ engineers across 10+ product teams rely on every day.

We enable the product teams rather than acting as gatekeepers. Product teams own their services end-to-end, including their infrastructure code, monitoring, cloud cost and first response to incidents. We give them a safe and well-documented platform, guardrails and self-service tools. Thus the teams can do routine work themselves, also in production.

You join this small team as a senior individual contributor. People management is not part of the role. As the team grows, a path to a technical lead role is possible.

Your opportunity

You will share these responsibilities with the rest of the infrastructure team:

  • Keeping the platform simple and reliable across our AWS accounts and networks, the public edge, Kubernetes (EKS), the service mesh (Istio), and the GitOps pipelines
  • Securing the platform against DDoS attacks, AI-assisted cyber-attacks, running bug-bounty programs
  • Evolving our architecture to support dedicated, single-tenant deployments across regions and cloud providers
  • Maintaining infrastructure as code in Terraform and ArgoCD, and making it easy and safe for all the teams
  • Operating telemetry (metrics, logs, tracing) infrastructure, helping teams define SLOs and alerts, and measure their services
  • Owning tools and processes for disaster recovery, including performing regular restore tests
  • Building tools, patterns, and documentation with which other teams can provision, deploy and operate their services without the infrastructure team's direct involvement
  • Helping to keep the petabyte-scale infrastructure cost-efficient
  • Keeping up with the compliance requirements (such as SOC 2)
  • Participating in the working hours support rotation, addressing incidents, helping other teams, finding and removing root causes of recurring problems

On-call: the role has no on-call duty at this time.

What we expect from you

  • Proven experience at a senior level in SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering
  • Hands-on infrastructure experience with a public cloud (AWS preferred), infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD and Kubernetes
  • Strong skills in software engineering, in systems engineering, or in both. For example, you write production-quality code in Python or Go. Or you know Linux and distributed systems well enough to debug complex production problems
  • Experience with observability, including metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and SLOs/SLIs
  • You can investigate complex failures, communicate clearly during an incident, and change your findings into durable improvements

About GetGround

GetGround is the all-in-one platform for UK property investors, helping landlords find, finance, structure and manage buy-to-let investments, and prepare and file their tax returns. Investors around the world trust us with their companies, finances and property.

Purpose of the role

You will assist with the design and running of GetGround's data privacy and AI governance programmes day to day, working closely with the Senior Director - Legal, Risk & Compliance. You will advise teams, keep our compliance records current, handle rights requests and breaches, and build our AI governance framework so that the AI tools we use are lawful and well controlled.

Data privacy responsibilities

  • Advise teams on their obligations under the UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, PECR and the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025.

  • Run the data privacy compliance programme to the DPO's assurance plan, covering policies, records of processing, retention, training and audits.

  • Support business owners to complete DPIAs and keep the DPIA register.

  • Deliver the data protection framework for Self Assessment and Making Tax Digital processing

  • Review data-sharing, processor and partner agreements, including white-label partnerships, and international transfer arrangements.

  • Handle subject access and other rights requests and data privacy complaints; prepare breach assessments with Information Security for the DPO's decision.

  • Prepare data privacy evidence for partner due diligence.

  • Deliver data privacy training and keep the Senior Director and business up to date on legal and regulatory changes

AI governance responsibilities

  • Build and maintain a register of AI systems and use cases, including third-party tools, with an owner and risk rating for each.

  • Run risk assessments for new AI use cases, combined with DPIAs where personal data is involved, covering accuracy, bias, transparency and human oversight.

  • Maintain the Responsible Use of AI Policy and governance framework, and deliver AI training.

  • Advise on safeguards for automated decision-making, including the right to human review.

  • Review AI vendors and model providers before onboarding, and keep a log of AI incidents, tracking each to closure.

  • Prepare reports to the Risk & Compliance Committee on data privacy and AI governance.

In addition to the above, the role will involve contributing to a number of strategic growth projects across the business and collaborating closely with other members of the Legal, Risk & Compliance team to build a scalable and comprehensive approach to managing data privacy and AI risk, enabling proper governance, oversight and streamlined legal, risk and compliance processes.

Skills and experience

Essential

  • Expert, current knowledge of UK data protection law and ICO guidance.

  • Working knowledge of AI governance, including ICO guidance on AI and data protection, the EU AI Act, and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

  • At least five years in a data privacy role in a company, such as data protection manager or privacy lead, with experience of governing AI or automated decision-making.

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, proptech or another regulated, data-heavy business.

  • Track record of running DPIAs and AI risk assessments, handling incidents and managing rights requests at volume.

  • Ability to turn legal requirements into practical, commercial advice, and the confidence to challenge and execute on tasks within tight timeframes

Desirable

  • IAPP CIPP/E or CIPM, or the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection; IAPP AIGP; a legal qualification.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
jobs.description:
Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.



What You Will Do

  • Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform.

  • Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams.

  • Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build.

  • Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use.

  • Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails.

  • Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior.

  • Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features.

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping.

  • Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed.

  • Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root.

  • Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on.

  • Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur.

  • Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI.

  • Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams.

What You Bring

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production.

  • Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices.

  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management.

  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations.

  • Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.

  • Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break.

  • Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python preferred) to build tooling, automate checks, and prototype mitigations.

  • Experience securing cloud-native systems, ideally on Azure, including CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub) and infrastructure-as-code.

Android Engineer

Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.

Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps.

This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.


What You'll Build & Own

  • On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.

  • Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.

  • Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.

  • Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.

  • AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.

What You Bring

  • Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system.

  • Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns.

  • Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end.

  • AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role.

✨ Why join us?

  • 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance)

You’ll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Procurement, Product, Privacy, Compliance, Security and Finance to deliver practical, business-oriented solutions. This is an operator role for an attorney who can personally review, negotiate, resolve and close a significant volume of matters while exercising sound judgment about when to accept risk, when to negotiate and when to escalate.

We are an AI-forward legal team. You will use approved AI and automation tools every day to increase contracting velocity, resolve escalations faster, improve consistency and reduce repetitive legal effort while maintaining appropriate human judgment over material decisions, and you will help rethink how the work gets done.

Beyond your core work, this role offers meaningful exposure to product counseling, data privacy, compliance and corporate governance, giving you room to broaden your practice as the team and the business grow.

An intellectually curious, highly analytical, commercially minded and solutions-oriented attorney who thrives in a high-volume environment. You are fast without being careless, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and focused on closing matters rather than becoming another step in the process. You experiment with new AI tools before being asked, want to understand how the product actually works and enjoy stretching into adjacent areas of law. You communicate clearly with customers, vendors and internal stakeholders, and you understand that Legal’s role is to help the business operate intelligently and at speed.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Contracting & MSA Deviations

  • Review, negotiate and approve a high volume of customer-requested deviations from the Company’s standard MSA and related terms, applying playbook positions and exercising sound judgment on non-standard requests.
  • Draft, review and negotiate a high volume of customer commercial agreements, including SaaS agreements, master services agreements, order forms, amendments, statements of work, software licenses, services agreements, non-disclosure agreements and service-level agreements.
  • Quickly distinguish material legal and commercial risk from issues that do not justify slowing a transaction, and develop practical fallback positions and escalation paths.

Customer Escalations

  • Serve as a senior Legal escalation point for customer matters involving contractual rights and obligations, service issues, credits, disputes, termination rights, liability and other commercial concerns.
  • Use approved AI tools to rapidly assess the Company’s contractual position, contract history, business exposure, customer importance and practical resolution options, then provide clear recommendations that move matters toward resolution.

Ancillary & Data Agreements

  • Review and negotiate ancillary agreements and addenda, including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), EU Data Act addenda, security and privacy addenda, confidentiality agreements, AI and data-use provisions and product-specific terms.

Procurement

  • Provide commercial legal support for selected procurement matters, including software, technology, services, vendor and licensing agreements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product, Privacy, Compliance, Security and Engineering on contract commitments and product-adjacent issues involving privacy, data, security, artificial intelligence, software functionality and technology regulation.

AI-Enabled Legal Operations

  • Use approved AI tools to accelerate first-pass contract review, MSA deviation analysis, clause analysis, redlining, summarization, research, comparison and issue identification.
  • Build and improve AI-assisted workflows, playbooks, clause libraries, standard positions and self-service resources that increase Legal’s throughput and consistency.
  • Train Sales, Customer Success, Procurement and other business teams on contractual terms, negotiation parameters, escalation triggers and available legal self-help resources.
  • Support continuous improvement in contract management processes, legal operations and cross-functional workflows.

Additional Matters

  • Assist with additional day-to-day commercial, privacy, compliance and product-adjacent legal matters as business needs arise.

Required Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • Approximately 7–12+ years of relevant legal experience, with meaningful in-house commercial experience strongly preferred.
  • Significant hands-on experience drafting and negotiating SaaS, software, technology and commercial customer agreements, including high-volume MSA negotiations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of simultaneous transactions, customer escalations and high-priority matters.
  • Experience negotiating privacy and data-related contractual terms, including DPAs and similar agreements; experience with BAAs and EU Data Act addenda is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working directly with sophisticated Sales, Customer Success, Product, Security, Procurement and Finance organizations.
  • Strong working knowledge of SaaS business models, software contracting, privacy, data security, intellectual property, indemnification, limitation of liability and related commercial risk issues.
  • Practical, daily experience using generative AI, AI contract review, contract lifecycle management automation or other LegalTech tools in legal work, and genuine curiosity about where these tools can take legal work next.
  • Strong analytical, negotiating, writing and communication skills, with the ability to provide concise, actionable business advice.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach, coupled with the independence and judgment required to operate effectively at the Director level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, infrastructure software, cloud or enterprise technology company strongly preferred.
  • Interest in growing into data privacy, compliance and product counseling.

Organic Growth & Content Manager (m/f/d)

Make Cosuno the leading digital authority in the construction industry.

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're transforming one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries through technology, proprietary data and artificial intelligence.

As our Organic Growth & Content Manager, you'll make Cosuno impossible to overlook, wherever our customers search, learn and form opinions. From Google and AI assistants to industry publications, social media and professional networks, you'll establish Cosuno as a trusted source of knowledge and innovation.

You'll own our organic growth and content strategy, turning our unique market data, customer expertise and technological innovation into a competitive advantage. Your ambition goes beyond generating traffic: you'll build industry authority, create demand and turn visibility into measurable business growth.

You'll join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, our website relaunch, and become one of the first members of a growing marketing team, with significant freedom to shape how we operate.

What you'll do

Build an industry-leading content strategy

  • Content strategy & editorial direction: Develop a unified content strategy informed by customer needs, search demand, industry trends and commercial priorities.

  • Thought leadership: Establish Cosuno as an authoritative industry voice through original research, market intelligence, whitepapers, industry reports and expert perspectives, leveraging our proprietary construction data.

  • Customer references & storytelling: Build a strong portfolio of customer success stories, case studies and testimonials that demonstrate measurable value and strengthen credibility.

  • Content distribution: Build a scalable content ecosystem that repurposes and distributes content across our website, blog, LinkedIn, newsletters, trade media, partner channels and sales enablement.

  • Editorial excellence: Manage freelance writers and external contributors, ensuring consistent quality, relevance and brand positioning across all formats.

Own organic visibility across search and AI

  • On-site SEO: Own our organic website performance, including technical SEO, content architecture, landing pages, Marketplace pages and programmatic SEO.

  • Off-site SEO & digital PR: Build domain and brand authority through backlinks, editorial placements, industry publications, relevant directories, guest contributions and strategic content partnerships.

  • AI search (GEO & AEO): Establish Cosuno as a frequently referenced and recommended source across AI-powered search engines and assistants, optimizing both our own content and our presence across external sources.

  • Website relaunch: Own the SEO strategy, requirements and migration alongside our website agency, turning the relaunch into a significant organic growth opportunity.

Build a scalable organic growth engine

  • AI-powered execution: Work with our GTM & Growth Engineer to automate research, content production, optimization, distribution and reporting without compromising quality.

  • Experimentation: Explore new content formats, data-driven landing pages, interactive tools and distribution opportunities. Scale what generates measurable results.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation and industry experts to ensure content creates value across the entire customer journey.

  • Performance & measurement: Track organic visibility, AI search presence, engagement, qualified sign-ups, demo requests and pipeline contribution.

Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you'll also oversee our organic LinkedIn presence and founder communications, establishing the editorial foundations for future collaboration.

What you bring

We're looking for someone who combines the analytical mindset of a growth marketer with the editorial judgment of a content strategist.

  • Organic growth expertise: You've owned SEO and content strategy in B2B SaaS or a digital marketplace, with measurable impact on acquisition or pipeline.

  • Strong SEO fundamentals: You're experienced in technical, on-page and off-page SEO, including website migrations and scalable content architectures.

  • AI search expertise: You understand GEO, AEO and the role of external sources, brand authority and structured content in AI-generated recommendations.

  • Content strategy experience: You've built editorial strategies across formats and channels, including thought leadership, customer stories and research-led content.

  • Editorial excellence: You write exceptional German, develop compelling narratives and know how to turn complex topics and proprietary data into accessible, authoritative content.

  • Distribution mindset: You understand that great content is only valuable if it reaches the right audience. You're comfortable building media relationships and content partnerships.

  • Analytical mindset: You're proficient in Search Console, GA4, Semrush or similar tools and measure success beyond traffic and rankings.

  • AI-first mentality: You leverage AI and automation to increase output and quality, rather than relying on manual execution.

  • Ownership: You're proactive, comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build a function from the ground up.

  • AI at the core: Work with the latest AI technologies and dedicated engineering support to bring ambitious ideas to life.

  • Competitive compensation: Above-market salary and a permanent contract in a stable, well-funded technology company.

  • Flexibility: Fully remote or from our Berlin Kreuzberg office, with flexible working hours.

  • Top equipment: A new MacBook Pro and access to the tools you need.

  • A great team: An ambitious, international team with regular off-sites, team events and an open feedback culture.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, yet much of it still runs on fragmented information, spreadsheets and manual processes.

We're changing that.

Cosuno combines an intelligent marketplace, proprietary industry data and artificial intelligence to transform how construction companies find partners, manage tenders and award contracts.

Join us and help shape the voice of the future of construction.

Wir sind New Monday und bringen erfahrene Spezialist in Kundenprojekte entlang des digitalen Produktentwicklungsprozesses. Unsere Wurzeln liegen im UX- und UI-Design. Deine Aufgaben

Für ein langfristiges Kundenprojekt suchen wir einen Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Engineer (gn). Du entwickelst und betreibst skalierbare, sichere Azure-Cloud-Plattformen und modernisierst die Engineering- und Entwicklungstools internationaler Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Automatisierung der Infrastruktur, der Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD-Pipelines und der Bereitstellung cloudnativer Services.

  • Du konzipierst, implementierst, administrierst und betreibst Azure-Cloud-Infrastrukturen und -Services.

  • Du automatisierst Infrastruktur und Deployments mit Terraform und OpenTofu und administrierst und optimierst Kubernetes-Plattformen.

  • Du entwickelst, pflegst und optimierst CI/CD-Pipelines und setzt GitOps-Konzepte mit FluxCD und ArgoCD um.

  • Du entwickelst C#/.NET-Anwendungen und Engineering-Tools, stellst sie bereit und integrierst und betreibst sie in der bestehenden Toollandschaft.

  • Du überwachst die Plattformen, analysierst und behebst Störungen, koordinierst Incidents und führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch.

  • Du optimierst die Performance der Cloud-Infrastruktur und unterstützt Cloud-Migrationen und Modernisierungsvorhaben.

  • Du setzt Cloud-Sicherheitskonzepte um und arbeitest im Identity- und Secrets-Management mit Keycloak und HashiCorp Vault.

  • Du arbeitest mit internationalen Entwicklungs- und Betriebsteams in einem agilen Umfeld zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung

  • Azure Cloud Engineering, DevOps Engineering oder Platform Engineering

Mehr als 4 Jahre Erfahrung

  • C#, .NET Core und .NET Framework

  • Terraform und Infrastructure as Code

  • CI/CD und CI/CD-Pipelines

  • Cloud Computing, cloudbasierte Anwendungen und Docker-/Cloud-Technologien

  • XML und YAML

  • Softwareentwicklung, Anwendungsentwicklung und -wartung sowie Tools-/Prozesssoftware

  • Verteilte Systeme und Netzwerke

  • Kubernetes

  • Troubleshooting und Debugging

  • .NET-Entwicklungs- und Deployment-Prozesse

  • Bash

Mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung

  • Linux-Administration

  • Unix Shells

  • Cybersecurity

  • Scripting, Automatisierung, Monitoring und Alerting

Weitere Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung mit Git, DevOps-Prinzipien, cloudnativen Architekturen und agilen Entwicklungsmethoden

  • Erfahrung in internationalen Entwicklungsteams

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, des Software Engineerings, der Medizintechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative sowie Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt.

  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen.

  • Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.

Du fühlst dich angesprochen und erfüllst einzelne Anforderungen für dieses Projekt (noch) nicht? Melde dich trotzdem gern bei uns. jobs.title: Strategy & Operations (3-6 YoE)
jobs.description:
Strategy & Operations (3-6 YoE)

Strategy & Operations (3-6 YoE)

London, 5x days per week in-office

 

Vega is looking for multi-disciplinary A players who have what it takes to build a business from the ground up. We hire people who are already high-performers in MBB or finance/investing, but still have the itch to do more. This role will sit in the CEO Office, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Growth, working across the highest strategic priorities in the business.

 

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

 

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

 

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

 

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

 

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Context-switch across strategy, go-to-market, operations, client delivery, external comms, special projects, and investor relations

  • Take on client-facing engagement responsibilities as needed, owning the day-to-day relationship and delivery coordination for enterprise customers.

  • Be able to own projects from Day 1, including representing Vega externally

  • Sit in the CEO Office, reporting directly to the Head of Strategy & Growth

  • Work closely with the Product & Growth and Engineering teams - strategy is not a silo at Vega

 

What we look for:

  • Required: 3-6 years of experience in MBB or finance/investing at a Tier 1 institution, with a clear spike in strategic thinking.

  • Whilst stellar training is essential, this is not all that we look for and not everyone with a background in MBB/investing will do well. This role is for people who have high standards of excellence for themselves, along with the risk tolerance and ambition to go beyond the comfort zone and structure of a larger institution.

  • Low ego, and a willingness to get stuck in; this role will allow you to do career-accelerating things that you might otherwise wait decades to do - but there will also be gruntwork. Everyone at Vega, including leadership, handles both.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills. You will need to think and explain complex concepts and communicate them to a range of stakeholders (e.g., enterprise customers, business, tech, and ops teams) with different audiences.

  • Confidence and judgement, with the ability to decide when and how to challenge requests, and an awareness of scalability and trade-offs when making those judgement calls.

 

Why join us?

  • Get a first-hand view, and real ownership of, everything that it takes to operate a fast-growing business

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

 

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive Vega’s ISO 27001 certification programme, building out and running the information security management system (ISMS) behind it, with policies that reflect how Vega works. Maintain our SOC 2 attestation with no exceptions.

  • Own client security assurance: answer due diligence questionnaires, maintain our supplier risk profiles and join client calls to explain how we protect their data, turning requirements such as UK GDPR and DORA into concrete controls and contractual positions.

  • Automate compliance, scripting evidence collection and control checks so that assurance comes from systems, not screenshots.

  • Help embed security across the SDLC: threat modelling with product and engineering teams, design and API reviews, CI/CD and repository controls.

  • Scope and manage external security testing, set up automated external scanning, challenge the findings and drive remediation to closure.

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in security with a substantial compliance/GRC share, including hands-on experience of ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits. Ideally you’ve been part of a team that took an organisation through ISO 27001 certification.

  • A real drive for security. You spot gaps and close them without being asked and get more satisfaction from protecting systems than breaking them.

  • Strong engineering ability and a solid grasp of application, API and SDLC security. You design and build robust scripts, using AI where it helps, with correctness, accuracy and presentation driving the output. Python is preferred.

  • Desirable: UK GDPR and DORA knowledge, a financial services background and familiarity with Java or Node.js.

Why join us?

  • Shape Vega’s security programme from the ground up, influencing how we secure our infrastructure, products and client data, with the autonomy to build and make a tangible impact in a fast-growing, AI-native startup.

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

Fractional Chief Medical Officer - Tricorder Systems

Fractional Chief Medical Officer — Project Tricorder

We're looking for a clinician who has served as a military medic to be Tricorder's clinical lead and the medical name behind the product. You'll shape clinical workflows, protect patient safety, help to roadmap clinical device regulation, giving the product credibility with clinicians, defence customers and investors.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. But the moments that decide outcomes often happen elsewhere: at the point of injury, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder is building deployable clinical infrastructure for that world. It's a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It's a dual-use venture serving defence medical first and civilian pre-hospital and humanitarian care next.

Tricorder is being built inside Founders Factory's venture studio, with dedicated pre-seed investment and a six-month build programme. The founder, a former British Army officer, is in place, the founding engineer is incoming, and a few more team hires are underway.

What you'll do

You'll be Tricorder's senior clinical voice: the person who makes sure what we build works for a medic at the point of injury and keeps patients safe.

  • Shape clinical workflows: map how casualties are assessed, treated, handed over and evacuated, from the point of injury through to definitive care. Turn that into product requirements, and test prototypes against real resuscitation and trauma scenarios.

  • Protect patient safety: lead clinical risk management and act as (or help appoint) the Clinical Safety Officer under the NHS DCB0129 standard. Advise on the evidence needed for the medical device and regulatory pathway.

  • Be the medical face of the product: put your clinical name to Tricorder. Represent it to defence medical services, NHS and ambulance trusts, humanitarian organisations and investors, and help the founder carry the clinical story in pitches and pilots.

  • Open doors: use your network across defence medicine, the NHS and humanitarian response to secure clinical pilots, user testing and early design partners.

  • Guide clinical evidence: help design pilots and early studies, and review clinical claims, protocols and terminology across the product and its AI features.

  • Advise the team: be a sounding board for the founder and build team on clinical priorities. Help with clinical hiring as the company grows.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • You've served as a military medic or doctor. This is non-negotiable. You know operational medicine first-hand, from point-of-injury care to the field hospital.

  • A GMC-registered doctor with deep experience in resuscitation, trauma or emergency surgery, emergency medicine, or pre-hospital care.

  • Still active clinically, whether as a reservist, in the NHS, or in humanitarian or disaster response.

  • You're credible with senior defence medical leaders, NHS clinicians and investors, and comfortable being the named clinical lead for a product.

  • You can turn clinical reality into clear, practical product decisions, and you're happy working with engineers and designers at startup pace.

Nice to have

  • Experience advising or working with medtech or health-tech startups, ideally as a CMO, clinical lead or advisor.

  • Clinical Safety Officer training (DCB0129/DCB0160), or experience with medical device regulation (UKCA/CE, ISO 14971).

  • Leadership roles in defence medical services, such as a clinical lead, medical director or command role.

  • Experience with mass-casualty planning, deployed hospital care, or global health systems.

  • Familiarity with clinical AI, data standards or digital health interoperability.

Probably not the right fit if

  • You haven't served in a military medical role.

  • You're looking for a passive advisory title without hands-on involvement in the product.

Stage Développement C++ & Intelligence Artificielle générative

Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre logiciel Track Builder, outil d’aide à la génération de lignes ferroviaires destinées à la simulation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d’études pour concevoir un framework intelligent de migration et de compatibilité logicielle, développé en C++ et assisté par l’Intelligence Artificielle.

Le Track Builder évolue régulièrement, entraînant des modifications de son architecture, de ses modèles de données, de ses couches SIG (QGIS), de ses formats de configuration (XML/XSD) et de ses composants logiciels. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données.

L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants.

Les principales missions seront :

  • Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions.
  • Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés.
  • Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates).
  • Développer un moteur de validation automatique permettant de contrôler l'intégrité et la cohérence des projets après migration.
  • Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations.
  • Participer à l'intégration du framework dans le processus de développement et le pipeline CI/CD du Track Builder.

Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation, avec des applications concrètes dans le domaine ferroviaire.

jobs.title: AI Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Robotics Engineer

inspire AG is the leading Swiss competence centre for product innovation and advanced manufacturing. As a strategic partner of ETH Zurich, our mission is to transfer knowledge and technology from research to Swiss machine, electrical and metal industries. The research group Intelligent Production Systems at inspire is based in Lugano, the southern part of Switzerland.

Our research group focuses on the development of AI algorithms for industrial applications. The main scope of our activities is the optimization and automation of workflows and production systems. Within this field, we are continuously developing and adopting various algorithms for multiple applications such as automating quality control, detecting process deviations and finally predicting the resulting product quality of the production systems.

We are looking for somebody to further push the activities around humanoids, dual-arm robots and mobile manipulators and we want to move fast. Our goal: automate industrial tasks that are still done by hand today, such as assembly, machine tending, handling and inspection, by combining modern robot hardware with AI for perception, manipulation and task learning.

You will have the opportunity to lead own topics and push the current boundaries. The role is like being part of a startup, but with the backing of an established research institute, connections to ETH Zurich and a strong network of Swiss industrial partners.

We are looking for a hands-on, highly proactive builder with an entrepreneurial mindset: someone who spots opportunities and gets a robot doing something useful within weeks. This position sits at the interface between research and industry.

Your Tasks

  • Build and own robotic demonstrators end to end, from concept to a working system on real hardware

  • Develop AI for quality control, perception and manipulation for industrial tasks

  • Integrate and program robot platforms (humanoids, dual-arm robots, cobots, mobile manipulators) using ROS 2, motion planning and simulation tools

  • Scout the fast-moving humanoid and embodied AI landscape: evaluate platforms, foundation models and suppliers and translate trends into concrete opportunities for Swiss industry

  • Identify automation use cases with industrial partners and run feasibility studies and pilots directly on the shop floor

  • Take ideas from concept to launch

  • Coordinate industry and grant projects, both technically and organizationally

Required qualifications & experiences

  • A PhD in robotics or mechanical or electrical engineering, or a Master's degree with an outstanding track record

  • Hands-on experience with real robot hardware, not only simulation

  • A proven track record in robot learning, perception or manipulation is a plus

  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++, and experience with ROS/ROS 2

  • Solid experience with deep learning frameworks and robot simulation (e.g. Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo)

  • Experiences in applied research, industrial R&D or a robotics startup

  • A startup or entrepreneurial mindset: you take initiative, ship prototypes fast and make things happen rather than waiting for direction

  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, combined with a structured, solution-oriented way of working

  • The ability to turn technical ideas into projects

  • Excellent English, plus fluency in at least one of German, Italian or French; a further national language is an advantage

  • CH/EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit

We offer

  • The chance to push robotics activity with real ownership

  • Access to robot hardware and lab infrastructure to test ideas quickly

  • Exciting topics and projects spanning academia and industry, at the forefront of AI for manufacturing

  • A flexible working culture with self-organized job execution and short decision paths

  • Close cooperation with industrial partners and the chance to build your own network

  • Participation in conferences, workshops and exhibitions

  • Guidance and internal training from experienced professionals to support your growth

By submitting application documents, you accept the provisions of the privacy policy of inspire.

HR-Stagiair(e)

Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen.


Jouw stage:

Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Waar draag je aan bij?

  • Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten.

  • Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie.

  • De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie).

  • Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten.

  • Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties.

  • Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen.

Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken een stagiair(e) die:

  • Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027.

  • Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week.

  • Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development.

  • Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels.

  • Nauwkeurig werkt, durft te vragen en zelfstandig durft te handelen.

  • Begeleiding van ervaren HR-professionals.

  • Stagevergoeding van € 650,- per maand op basis van 40 uur.

  • Meedoen met ons Be-Fit programma; wekelijks sporten met collega’s.

  • Ook gewoon een superleuke tijd!

Over Benchmark

Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s).

Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met productie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd.

Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s.

Benchmark wil vooruit, samen met jou als HR-Stagiair(e)!
