jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance
jobs.description:
Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance

Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help shape how data is modeled and governed at Airalo, transforming first- and third-party data into clean, trusted, well-documented datasets that power decisions across product, marketing, finance, and commercial teams, serving 30+ million users and growing. This role carries particular weight in our finance and revenue domain: you’ll steward the models finance relies on directly, including order-to-revenue flows and reconciliation against third-party systems such as our ERP, where precision and auditability matter as much as scalability.

Our analytics engineering function is still maturing, so you’ll have real ownership in establishing standards, defining our semantic layer, and shaping how data is structured as we scale globally, working closely with the rest of the data team to build a production-grade analytics platform on LightDash and beyond.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain data models using dbt within our cloud data warehouse, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and alignment with business logic

  • Build and maintain finance and revenue data models, including order-to-revenue flows, recognition logic, and reconciliation against source-of-truth financial systems, that finance and commercial teams can rely on for reporting and forecasting

  • Own the order-to-revenue pipeline: ensuring every order correctly and traceably resolves into recognized revenue, with clear handling of refunds, adjustments, currency conversion, and edge cases

  • Collaborate with other analytics engineers and data engineers to build and scale ELT workflows that ensure data freshness and reliability for mission-critical reporting

  • Partner with Finance and the ERP systems integrator to validate that data models and definitions carry over correctly from legacy systems into the new ERP/EPM platform

  • Implement robust testing, documentation, and monitoring practices, acting as a steward of data quality and governance across the platform, with particularly high attention to detail in domains where small errors compound (e.g., revenue, finance)

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to translate complex business questions into scalable, production-ready data artifacts

  • Partner with the data analysts and domain leadership to drive the rollout and adoption of self-service analytics, ensuring business users can trust and independently explore the data models you build

  • Contribute to the evolution of our modern data stack, bringing curiosity and pragmatic judgment to new tools and approaches

Must Haves:

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, or equivalent work experience)

  • Hands-on experience building finance and/or revenue data models, ideally including order-to-revenue or billing-to-revenue pipelines, revenue recognition logic, or financial reconciliation (ERP, billing platforms or similar)

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or analytics roles with significant modeling responsibilities

  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills, with demonstrated experience designing robust, scalable dimensional models

  • Exceptional attention to detail, especially when working with numbers that feed financial reporting, reconciliation, or external disclosure

  • Significant hands-on experience with dbt (Core or Cloud) for managing transformation logic, testing, and documentation

  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (BigQuery) and data orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)

  • Experience working with modern BI platforms and semantic layers-LightDash experience is a strong plus

  • Track record of partnering with analysts and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-structured data products

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to diverse audiences

  • Proactive self-starter who thrives on solving ambiguous problems and takes ownership from concept to production

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in marketplace, telecom, or travel/mobility businesses

  • Background in B2C product companies with high-volume event data

  • Experience building analytics engineering capabilities in low-maturity data environments

  • Previous experience at a scale-up that went through hypergrowth

  • Experience defining and governing company-wide KPIs and metric frameworks

  • Experience working alongside or within a finance function (e.g., supporting FP&A, revenue accounting, or audit processes) on data accuracy and traceability

Compensation

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍

This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it's available:

📍 UK: £74,800 – £112,200
📍 Spain: €77,600 – €116,400
📍 Germany: €76,000 - €114,000

Your Home Destination: 🛫 Local market rates and cost of living vary, so your specific range depends on where you’re based. Most people join in the first half of the band, which leaves you plenty of room to grow, and you’ll see exactly how that looks from day one. In exceptional cases, where a candidate’s skills and experience clearly exceed what the role requires, we’re happy to talk about going higher. We’ll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team, so we’re all aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

Additional Information

Why People Join Us

🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

This is a high visibility, high impact role that sits at the intersection of data-driven analysis and executive-level decision making. You will work closely with senior leadership to develop strategic recommendations, lead analytical workstreams, and drive special initiatives across the business.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in financial modeling and quantitative analysis — honed through investment banking, management consulting, or corporate finance — combined with intellectual curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in how AI tools are reshaping the way strategy work gets done.

Soft Skills

Why This Role

jobs.title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer, EMEA
jobs.description:
Applied Machine Learning Engineer, EMEA

About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you are the technical owner of a customer engagement. This is what is globally known as the Forward Deployed Engineer role; at Fireworks in EMEA it carries the AMLE title. You embed with a small number of accounts, work in their environment, and own whatever stands between them and production on Fireworks: the model, the serving path, the integration, the performance. You scope the work before signature and deliver what you scoped. Depth over breadth: few accounts, owned end to end.

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Four Spikes:

  1. Software engineering. You ship production systems and are comfortable dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or a customer environment with a deadline. Backend and systems depth, strong Python plus at least one systems language, and fluency with AI-assisted and agentic engineering as a core part of how you build.

  2. Machine learning. You take open models and make them better on a customer's task: SFT, LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods, reinforcement learning (RLHF, RLVR), distillation. Just as important, you design evaluations that reflect the real task and let them drive training decisions, and you know when fine-tuning is not the answer.

  3. Infrastructure and performance. You know your GPUs: memory bandwidth, kernels, parallelism, what utilization numbers actually mean. Serving and inference optimization: quantization, speculative decoding, batching, KV cache behavior, latency vs throughput tradeoffs, multi-GPU and multi-node serving, capacity planning. You can take a deployment that works and make it fast and economical, and reason about where the bottleneck is before touching a profiler.

  4. Customer engagement. You want to be in the room. The point of this role is creating specialized intelligence for each customer: the best model for their task, their data, their constraints. That takes real interest in the customer's problem, not just the technical one. Exceptional here looks like founder energy with customers; the floor is genuine appetite to embed, explain, and own outcomes with them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Engagements: Take customer deployments from scoping through production, as the single accountable technical owner.

  • Embed: Work directly inside customer teams; understand their domain, data, and constraints well enough to make decisions they trust.

  • Train and Tune: Run fine-tuning and post-training work where the engagement needs it, from data to evaluation to a model serving in production.

  • Optimize: Drive serving performance and cost on Fireworks: model choice, deployment shape, and inference optimization.

  • Scope Honestly: Assess what is achievable before we commit, and inherit what you scope.

  • Product Signal: Feed what customers need back to product and engineering, with enough precision to be actionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Spikes in two or all three areas.

  • For the ML spike: formal training (PhD, PhD in progress, or a strong MSc) and experience post-training LLMs specifically.

  • For the infrastructure spike: experience with GPU infrastructure, distributed serving, or inference engines.

  • Founder or founding engineer experience.

  • Experience in a startup or fast-paced environment.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Growth Partnerships + New Audiences
Senior Engineer - Platform & Tooling
jobs.description:
Senior Engineer - Platform & Tooling

Who is Atominvest

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big.

It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

About the role

Hi, I'm Thomas, VP Engineering at Atominvest. This is the hire I'm most excited about, so I wanted to tell you about it myself.

You'll own the platform our clients run on and build the AI development harness our engineers work in day to day. That work runs from infrastructure to application code, so we're looking for an experienced engineer with breadth across both, and depth in at least one. Together, it's what lets a small, lean team, working alongside AI agents, ship like a much bigger one.

 

By platform, we mean everything our product and our engineers stand on: infrastructure, security, test automation, developer experience, and the agent pipelines that run through all of them. It's a broad, hands-on role. You'll write infrastructure as code for a new service one day and address network vulnerabilities the next, then enhance our AI development harness and release a new feature, all within the same month.

 

You might be a platform engineer who loves shipping product, or a full-stack engineer who has run serious production infrastructure. Either works.

As deployments grow more complex, the team needs your depth in infrastructure and distributed systems. You'll strengthen the architecture and make the design decisions the platform will rest on for years. Those decisions should leave room to grow, because future products may bring much larger volumes of data than we handle today.

It has to stay dependable while we do it. Our software needs to be available around the clock, every day of the year, and data integrity is critical. Our clients use Atominvest to report to their own investors, so a wrong number matters as much as an outage. Security, reliability and audit-readiness matter too. If you enjoy getting those right without slowing everything else down, you'll find plenty of fun things to work on.

The machine that builds the product

We're becoming AI-native. Agents do more and more of the mechanical work of writing code, and engineers build the machine that builds the product: the architecture, the specs, the limits agents work within, and the evals that tell us whether their output is right.

I think that moves an engineer's leverage upstream. When code is cheap, the scarce things are judgement and understanding. Which problem is worth solving? What does good look like for the person using it? Is the output actually right? Did what we shipped help? The best engineers I've worked with always solved the end problem, with code as the medium. Now that's most of the job.

That's why product and user understanding sit at the centre of how we work. An engineer who knows our clients' workflows can point agents at the right problem and spot when the result is subtly wrong. Without that, agents just build the wrong thing faster.

Your part is the AI development harness that makes this safe. That means sandboxed environments with synthetic data, scoped and audited access to logs and alerts, and evals and validation gates in CI. It also means firm lines, enforced by tooling, that keep production deploys and secrets in human hands, and client data out of reach of development agents.

You'll also build the agent orchestration pipelines that run in three places: in how we build software, in AI workflows inside the product our clients use, and in the internal tools our implementation team uses to onboard and configure clients.

What you'll do

Build the machine that builds the product

Most of your time goes here.

  • Build our AI development harness. Self-service infrastructure, a reproducible development environment, and the sandboxes, guardrails and evals that let agents take on more of the work safely, with results we can measure.

  • Automate quality. Build the QA automation pipeline: automated tests, validation gates and release checks that give us confidence in every change, including the ones agents write.

  • Orchestrate agents across the business. Build pipelines that run agents reliably and safely in our product workflows and our internal implementation tools, not just in engineering.

Own the platform

  • Own our infrastructure. We're migrating to ECS. You'll strengthen our ECS architecture, see the move through in safe, reversible stages, bring every resource under infrastructure as code, and retire the old deployment model.

  • Build security into the platform. Tenant-scoped credentials, per-tenant secrets, least-privilege access, and the audit trail that SOC 2 and our clients' security teams expect.

  • Make production observable. Set up the monitoring, alerting and tracing we rely on, and build playbooks for on-call and incident response which is shared amongst the team.

Work across the stack

  • Make the application changes the harness needs, such as synthetic data, test hooks and the specs agents work from.

  • Ship product. Pick up application work in TypeScript and React alongside the team. Over time, you'll learn the codebase as well as the platform it runs on.

  • Grow the team around you. Write the design notes and runbooks, pair with and review the work of other engineers, and mentor those who want to grow into infrastructure, so the platform never depends on one person.

Your first six months

  • Get the first parts of "the machine" running, and show that they make the team faster without lowering quality.

  • At the moment all of our end to end testing is done manually by our Product team. That's a massive manual overhead that bottlenecks our product development. You'll help build our AI-powered QA automation pipeline, so every change, whether a person or an agent wrote it, is tested automatically before it reaches clients.

  • Strengthen the ECS architecture and complete the move with no disruption to clients.

  • Get the platform fully into code, with tenant isolation and least privilege designed in.

  • Put in place the monitoring and on-call foundations the team will build on.

How you'll work

You'll own this area rather than work through a ticket queue. You'll decide what to build and when it's good enough, write your decisions down so others can challenge them, and tell us when something isn't worth doing. You'll work closely with Product from the start of significant work, because the platform exists to serve clients and the engineers building for them.

You and I will work together every day. We'll shape the technical direction together and think through the hard calls, and you'll have a direct line to every decision that affects your work. I'll back your judgement, and I'll expect you to push back when you think I'm wrong.

This is an individual contributor role, but we expect you to multiply the team: leading different areas at different times, and delivering through others as well as through your own work.

You'll probably enjoy this if

  • You'd rather build a platform properly than keep patching one.

  • You're product-minded. You've probably worked at a startup or scale-up, or even founded something yourself. Seeing your work out in the world, solving real problems, is what motivates you. You ask who a change is for before you ask how to build it.

  • You already work this way. Agents write much of your code, and your time goes on design, specs and judging the output. You've built AI tooling for yourself, and probably for others on your team.

  • You get satisfaction from making other engineers faster.

  • You're comfortable writing Terraform, an API endpoint and an answer to a client's security questionnaire in the same week.

  • You've been the person others come to with hard problems, and you've changed your mind publicly when the evidence said so.

This probably isn't for you if

  • You want a pure DevOps or SRE role.

  • You want to manage people right now. These opportunities might exist in the future, but for now we're small, lean and as flat as possible.

What you'll bring

Very few people match every line. If most of this describes you, we'd like to hear from you.

  • Deep, hands-on AWS. Several years running production workloads on ECS or EKS, with a solid grasp of IAM, networking and Lambda.

  • Infrastructure as code as a habit, with Terraform or CloudFormation, including bringing existing hand-built resources under code.

  • Scaling distributed systems. You've taken systems through real growth in load and data, and can teach others what you learnt.

  • Single-tenant SaaS experience. You know the isolation trade-offs and how to keep one client's data and credentials away from another's.

  • Security and compliance as part of engineering: least privilege, secrets management, and evidence for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

  • Production experience: on-call, incidents, post-mortems, and observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana or Honeycomb.

  • Full-stack product building. Senior TypeScript and Node.js, plus React, with a track record of shipping features end to end yourself, not just supporting the people who do.

  • Test automation and CI/CD. You've designed pipelines that test at the right levels and release safely, and you keep them fast and simple.

  • Tooling you've built for AI agents, not just used: agent configuration and orchestration, MCP servers or similar integrations, evals, automated review.

Our stack

TypeScript, Node.js, React and MongoDB Atlas, running on AWS. CircleCI and Bitbucket. AI coding agents are part of everyday work. You don't need experience of all of these.

How we hire

We want to see how you actually work, so there are no whiteboard puzzles.

  1. Screening call with me (20 minutes)

  2. Competencies interview with me (30 minutes)

  3. Technical deep dive with a few of our engineers (90 minutes)

  4. Culture fit interview with our CEO, Hemal (30 minutes)

I'll be your main point of contact throughout. You'll know what to expect before each stage, and if we don't make an offer, I'll give you feedback.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant

This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be ideal to make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:
We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and scale the operational engine behind DeepJudge’s marketing and qualified pipeline growth.

This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign and attribution systems. You’ll act as a strategic and operational business partner to Content, Field, Demand Gen and Product Marketing, and work with Sales, RevOps and Partnerships to make sure every lead and target account reaches the right seller, and that we know which programs created the pipeline.

If you naturally think: “Which campaign actually created this opportunity, and why did it take three days to reach a rep?” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. You will play a key role in giving our growing sales team a reliable flow of qualified pipeline and in driving commercial success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead and account lifecycle

    • Own the lead and account lifecycle from first touch to sales-qualified opportunity, including lifecycle stages, MQL/SQL definitions and SLAs

    • Design and maintain lead scoring, inbound routing and assignment rules as the marketing and sales team grows

    • Run the Marketing-to-Sales handoff with clear acceptance criteria and feedback loops

  • Campaign, event and partner marketing operations

    • Administer HubSpot Marketing Hub and its integrations with ad, event and enrichment tools

    • Operationalize field and growth marketing: event lead capture, ABM programs, nurture workflows and partner campaigns

    • Own campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting

  • AI, automation, and marketing innovation

    • Identify, test and roll out AI tools and automations that measurably improve marketing performance, scalability and efficiency.

    • Build workflows connecting intent signals, enrichment, CRM, landing pages and advertising platforms, to power ABM and personalized campaigns at scale, in partnership with Demand Generation.

    • Turn successful experiments into repeatable processes, partnering with our GTM Engineer on complex integrations and shared technical infrastructure.

    • Partner with Demand Generation to scale campaigns through AI-assisted segmentation, dynamic landing pages and targeted advertising.

    • Experiment with emerging GTM technologies and turn successful prototypes into repeatable marketing processes.

  • Attribution and performance

    • Own campaigns and marketing attribution frameworks and pipeline source reporting.

    • Build and maintain marketing funnel dashboard, in terms of volume, stage conversion, velocity and campaign ROI.

    • Analyze marketing funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness.

  • Data quality and business partnership

    • Set and enforce marketing data standards: hygiene, enrichment, deduplication and consent management

    • Act as Operational business partner to Marketing, Sales and CSM, Partnership leadership

What success looks like in 12 months:

  • Every inbound lead and target account reaches the right owner within an agreed SLA

  • Marketing and Sales work from one shared set of lifecycle definitions and with a trusted MQL/SQL handoff

  • Field and Demand Gen spend measurably less time on admin because they can rely on an efficient system from lead to SQL

  • Leadership can see which campaigns, events and partners touched and created pipeline

  • Marketing data completeness and accuracy support leadership decision making

  • AI-powered workflows run in production across ABM and lifecycle marketing, with measurable gains in efficiency or performance

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years in Marketing Operations or Demand Generation Operations in B2B SaaS, including time at a high-growth company

  • Have deep hands-on expertise in HubSpot Marketing Hub administration (Marketo or Pardot also considered)

  • Have a proven track record designing lead lifecycle, scoring and routing for a sales team that scaled

  • Have experience building campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting

  • Have hands-on experience building automations and enrichment workflows (e.g. Clay, Zapier/n8n, ZoomInfo/Apollo, intent data)

  • Bring an analytical mindset with comfort in funnel math and data quality work

  • Have excellent stakeholder management across GTM teams

What you can look forward to:

  • Owning the marketing operations engine that supports marketing and feeds a growing sales team

  • Helping shape how a category-defining AI company builds and scales its go-to-market engine from the ground up

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager – Adoption & Accompagnement 80/100%

Le go-live, c’est seulement le début.


Chez RogerHR, notre accompagnement ne s’arrête pas à la mise en production. Une fois la plateforme en place, il reste à aider nos clients à en tirer pleinement parti, au quotidien et sur le long terme. Leurs besoins évoluent, et Roger aussi : de nouvelles fonctionnalités sortent régulièrement, et chacune peut leur faire gagner du temps… à condition de savoir qu’elle existe et de savoir s’en servir.


En tant que Customer Success Manager orienté adoption, tu deviens l’interlocuteur clé de nos clients après le démarrage. Ton rôle a un impact direct sur le quotidien des équipes RH : moins de tâches manuelles, des processus plus fluides, et plus de temps pour ce qui compte vraiment, l’humain.


Ton objectif : que chaque client soit autonome, satisfait et qu’il tire toujours plus de valeur d’une plateforme qui ne cesse de s’enrichir.

Vos missions

Faire vivre la relation client

  • Garder un contact régulier et proactif avec chaque client et faire avec lui le point sur son utilisation de Roger

  • Prendre le pouls de la satisfaction et repérer les signaux faibles (baisse d’usage, frustrations, changement d’interlocuteur)

  • Construire une relation de confiance durable avec les équipes RH, la direction et les key users

Analyser et améliorer les usages

  • Comprendre comment chaque client utilise réellement Roger, avec le recul de l’utilisation au quotidien

  • Analyser ses processus RH pour repérer les irritants, les contournements et les tâches manuelles qui subsistent

  • Proposer des pistes d’amélioration concrètes : paramétrage, fonctionnalités inexploitées, automatisations

  • Challenger avec bienveillance les habitudes en place quand une meilleure façon de faire existe

  • Conseiller les clients sur les bonnes pratiques RH et la bonne application des règles (temps de travail, absences, vacances…) dans Roger

Valoriser le travail accompli

  • Aider les équipes RH à valoriser en interne le travail accompli avec Roger, auprès de leur direction comme de leurs collaborateurs

  • Construire avec elles un business case concret : temps gagné, processus simplifiés, fiabilité des données, retour sur investissement

Rendre les clients autonomes

  • Former les key users et les nouveaux arrivants côté client

  • Expliquer, réexpliquer et vulgariser, avec patience et pédagogie

  • Créer ou enrichir les ressources d’auto-formation (guides, tutoriels, bonnes pratiques) pour garantir des pratiques harmonieuses entre nos clients

Faire découvrir les nouveautés

  • Suivre de près les évolutions de Roger et savoir à quels clients chaque nouveauté sera utile

  • Présenter les nouvelles fonctionnalités et aider les clients à les intégrer dans leurs processus

  • Organiser des sessions de découverte (webinars, démos ciblées, ateliers)

Contribuer à la croissance

  • Identifier les besoins non couverts et les opportunités d’upsell (nouveaux modules, intégrations, nouveau périmètre)

  • Accompagner l’équipe commerciale sur les opportunités détectées

  • Contribuer à la fidélisation et au renouvellement des contrats

Être la voix RH chez Roger

  • Partager ton expertise RH avec l’équipe (Customer Success, produit, développement) pour que Roger colle au plus près de la réalité du terrain

  • Faire remonter les retours clients à l’équipe produit et éclairer les choix grâce à ta connaissance des pratiques et des règles RH

  • Aider tes collègues à monter en compétence sur les sujets RH

Ton profil

Tu viens des RH et tu veux avoir un réel impact sur le quotidien de tes pairs.
Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience en ressources humaines : gestionnaire RH, HR business partner, responsable RH, administrateur SIRH ou consultant RH. Tu connais de l’intérieur le quotidien des équipes RH : la saisie manuelle, les fichiers Excel, les règles complexes à appliquer et le manque de temps pour les sujets à valeur ajoutée. Aujourd’hui, tu as envie de mettre cette expérience au service d’autres professionnels RH pour les aider à mieux travailler.


Chez Roger, tu seras à la fois un(e) allié(e) pour nos clients, qui parle leur langage et comprend leurs enjeux, et la référence RH de notre équipe, qui nous aide à construire un produit toujours plus juste.

Compétences essentielles

Hard skills

  • Expertise RH : tu maîtrises les processus RH (absences, vacances, temps de travail, cycle de vie des collaborateurs…) et les règles qui les encadrent, notamment le droit du travail suisse

  • Analyse de processus : tu sais décortiquer un fonctionnement existant et proposer des améliorations concrètes

  • Sens du business : tu sais chiffrer la valeur d’une amélioration et repérer les opportunités, sans jamais forcer la vente

  • Aisance avec les outils digitaux : tu as déjà utilisé un SIRH ou d’autres outils SaaS et tu aimes ça

  • Gestion de projets : tu suis plusieurs clients en parallèle sans en perdre un de vue

  • Français et anglais courants (l’allemand est un plus)

Soft skills

  • Envie d’impact : améliorer concrètement le quotidien des équipes RH te motive

  • Patience et pédagogie : tu aimes transmettre et tu ne te lasses pas d’expliquer

  • Écoute active : tu poses les bonnes questions et tu entends aussi ce qui n’est pas dit

  • Excellent relationnel : tu crées facilement la confiance et tu entretiens la relation dans la durée

  • Proactivité : tu n’attends pas que le client t’appelle, tu vas vers lui

  • Esprit d’équipe : tu aimes partager ce que tu sais et faire grandir les autres

Les PLUS qui feront la différence

✓ Expérience dans le paramétrage ou l’administration d’un SIRH
✓ Participation à un projet de digitalisation RH ou de mise en place d’un outil
✓ Expérience de la formation d’utilisateurs ou de la conduite du changement
✓ Brevet fédéral de spécialiste RH ou formation équivalente
✓ Expérience en startup ou en scale-up

Avantages

Environnement de travail

  • Télétravail flexible (1 jour/semaine au bureau et déplacements réguliers chez nos clients en Suisse romande)

  • Équipement de qualité selon goûts / besoins du collaborateur (laptop, écrans, etc.)

Culture & évolution

  • Un impact direct sur le quotidien de nombreuses équipes RH

  • Autonomie et responsabilités dès le départ

  • Une équipe dynamique et bienveillante

  • Des opportunités d’évolution rapides

Tu veux simplifier la vie de tes collègues RH ? Envoie-nous ton CV et quelques lignes sur ce qui te motive.

jobs.description:
Stageopdracht Video Content Creator

Over Noldus

Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers

wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen

worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot

ziekenhuizen en bedrijven.

We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons

beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige

stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en

aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen.

De stageopdracht

Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en

overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers?

Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe

videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team

bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste

kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je

zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

• Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke

mogelijkheden ze bieden.

• Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je

functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien.

• Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke

waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek.

• Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of

functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen.

• Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om

bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot

eindproduct.

• Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de

grootste kansen liggen.

• Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning.

• Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in

gebruik.

• Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt.

• Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe

huisstijl.

• Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en

andere digitale kanalen.

Wat willen we bereiken?

Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent

die:

• Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert.

• Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden

gebruikt.

• Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl.

• Op verschillende plekken binnen onze digitale klantreis kan worden ingezet.

Naast concrete video’s werk je aan een herkenbare visuele stijl en aanpak, zodat we ook in de

toekomst op een consistente manier nieuwe videocontent kunnen ontwikkelen.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een creatieve stage met veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief.

• De mogelijkheid om een project van concept tot eindproduct zelfstandig vorm te geven.

• Samenwerking met een enthousiast E-commerce team en verschillende productspecialisten.

• Een internationale en innovatieve werkomgeving.

• Concrete eindproducten die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt op onze website en digitale

kanalen.

• Een mooie kans om je portfolio uit te breiden met uiteenlopende videoproducties, animaties

en softwaredemo’s.

Het eindresultaat

Je levert niet alleen een aantal professionele video’s op, maar helpt Noldus ook om een nieuwe

standaard neer te zetten voor hoe we onze producten en technologie visueel presenteren.

Jouw creativiteit maakt onze innovaties zichtbaar!


Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een creatieve, enthousiaste student die het leuk vindt om ideeën om te zetten in

professioneel beeldmateriaal. Je volgt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in de richting van Creative

Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Audiovisuele Media of een vergelijkbare

creatieve opleiding.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

• Je hebt affiniteit met videoproductie, editing en visuele storytelling.

• Je kunt werken met tools zoals Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve of

vergelijkbare software.

• Je vindt het leuk om zowel te filmen als digitaal beeldmateriaal te creëren.

• Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op.

• Je bent creatief, neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of aantrekkelijker

kan.

• Je vindt het interessant om complexe software of technologie op een toegankelijke manier uit

te leggen.

Ervaring met animatie of motion graphics is een pluspunt.

To expand our team, we are looking for a talented and highly skilled consultant with a technical background to join our team. If you're a DevOps or ML Engineer or just starting out in the field of machine learning and/or DevOps engineering - if you never lose focus, love coding, data and AI, and are passionate about bringing your ideas to life - then we want to hear from you!

Engineering Lead

ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE

Engineering Lead for the Acquisition team. You’ll report to our Head of Engineering. You’ll work closely with the PM to lead the team toward its goals, owning delivery, operational reliability and developer experience. You’ll ship production code and provide technical coaching and leadership to the engineers around you, not line management. You’ll also shape how the team uses AI tools and coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Lead a team building products that directly drive Flock’s growth

  • Own delivery and technical quality for the Acquisition team, working hand in hand with the PM to ship features that directly impact how fleets find and choose Flock.

  • Write high-quality, well-tested TypeScript and own end-to-end delivery to production

Partner with product to drive impact

  • Work closely with the PM, the Engineering Leadership Team and stakeholders to translate business goals into clear technical scope, success metrics and delivery plans.

Grow engineers around you

  • Lead by example through code, design discussions and pairing.

  • Coach and mentor engineers across the team to raise standards and share ownership of technical direction.

Shape how the team works, not just what it builds

  • Drive improvements to developer experience, CI/CD, observability and release practices that make the whole team faster and more confident.

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs that balance reliability, performance and cost across AWS services.

  • Decide how the team uses AI, from coding assistants to agent workflows in review and release, keeping engineering judgement where it matters.

Curious how we build the future of fleet insurance? Dive into our Product & Engineering Blog, packed with technical deep-dives, behind-the-scenes stories, and real insights from the team you’d be joining.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

As an Engineering Lead at Flock you’ll own delivery and technical direction for the Acquisition team, co-leading with the PM to ship products that directly drive growth, while raising the bar for the engineers around you.

API-Driven Development

  • Integrate with and contribute to the development of RESTful APIs exposed via API Gateway.

Serverless & Cloud Infrastructure

  • Use your AWS experience (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch) to support and extend the Acquisition team’s services and pipelines.

  • Work with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CDK for provisioning and managing cloud resources.

Collaboration & Agile Delivery

jobs.title: AI software Engineer - Project Tricorder
jobs.description:
AI software Engineer - Project Tricorder

Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.

Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.

What you'll do

You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.

1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness

Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.

  • Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.

  • Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).

  • Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.

  • Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.

  • Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.

2. Clinical knowledge base

Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records.

  • Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.

  • Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them.

  • Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.

  • Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.

  • Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.

By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.

What we're looking for

We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other.

Must-haves

  • Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks.

  • Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models.

  • Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control.

  • Working knowledge of databases and data modelling.

  • Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing.

  • Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints.

  • Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding.

  • A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence.

  • Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets).

  • Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards.

  • Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment.

  • Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer.

Probably not the right fit if

  • You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective.

  • You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day.

This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team.

Performance Marketer, Acquisition

Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

About the Team

Our growth starts with reaching the right sellers and earning their trust. You'll join Growth & Marketing alongside Creative, CRM and Brand, and work in an acquisition squad with teammates from Product, Tech and Operations. A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead.

The Role

As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings.

Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll need to maintain lead quality in a crowded market: Meta and TikTok are starting to compete for the same audiences, and so are Google and ChatGPT.

You'll also help us use AI to manage campaigns, produce ads and analyze performance, so the team can manage more spend and run more tests with the same headcount.

What You'll Be Able to Do in a Year

Ad platforms report clicks and leads. At Zefir, you'll follow those leads through to booked meetings with Sales and use what you learn to decide where to spend.

  • Allocate €15M+ a year by cost per booked meeting. Compare costs across segments and recognise when fewer leads signal better performance.

  • Measure what your campaigns actually add. Design and interpret geo-lift or holdout tests to find out how many extra meetings a campaign generated, and use the results to move budget.

  • Run acquisition with AI. Build your own agents and automations for campaign management, ad production and performance analysis, then measure their impact.

  • Use campaign results to improve creative. Brief and challenge our agency and freelancers, then work with our Content Strategist to turn what you learn into the next round of tests.

What You'll Do

Set the paid acquisition strategy

  • Set quarterly targets with our Growth & Marketing Lead based on how sellers behave, how the market is changing and what competitors are doing.

  • Decide how to split spend across channels and campaigns to hit those targets and keep generating leads at a sustainable cost beyond the quarter.

  • Find and launch new paid channels and lead-generation partnerships.

Own daily performance and the €15M+ budget

  • Optimise campaigns daily with Sales, Brand and Product. When a campaign underperforms, reallocate spend that day.

  • Lead the weekly acquisition review: explain where we missed the plan, what drove the gap and what you'll do to close it.

  • Maximise return on the budget. Use the cost per booked sales meeting in each segment to decide where to put the next euro.

  • Work directly across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, ChatGPT and new platforms, and know the tracking stack end to end, from Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking to attribution.

Measure what drives growth

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead the engineering and integration of high-voltage power systems supporting critical plant operations

  • Define high-voltage electrical architectures, simulate power conversion and selection of electrical components

  • Perform and review key electrical studies, including insulation coordination, transient overvoltage, short-circuit protection, grounding, and safety analyses

  • Develop strategies for high-voltage system monitoring, diagnostics, and condition assessment to improve reliability and maintainability

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of high-voltage systems with plant infrastructure and control systems

  • Oversee testing, commissioning, and validation activities for high-voltage equipment and subsystems

  • Build a safety culture that protects our people first and equipment second, from the dangers inherent in high voltage systems

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field

  • You have experience designing, analyzing, or commissioning high-voltage electrical systems in industrial, utility, research, or energy applications

  • You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and developing innovative solutions where established approaches may not yet exist

  • Experience in the design and application of insulation systems, electric field management, and creepage and clearance coordination is a plus

  • Familiarity with protection systems, interlocking philosophies, and functional safety concepts for high-energy electrical installations is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

jobs.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)

Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)

Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
Senior Customer Success Manager - EMEA

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:
As a Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will be the post-sales primary point of contact for our customers. You will be responsible for taking lead on customer engagements across onboarding, implementation, and adoption. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering and Sales to ensure the successful onboarding and support of your customers. You are their day-to-day contact, building relationships with customers and driving outcomes, adoption, and delivering time-to-value.

What you’ll do:

  • Success Planning & Value: Drive business success planning by partnering with customers, pre-sales, and post-sales teams to align on requirements, goals, and challenges. Provide thought leadership on change management for large, scaled rollouts. Support the full Business Value Realization cycle to ensure customers can demonstrate and prove value internally.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for customer needs and requirements to internal teams. This means being a team player and having strong collaboration skills - this role must align with many different internal teams, influence them to act toward customer needs.
  • Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.
  • Product Expertise: Develop hands-on technical knowledge of Chainguard and stay up-to-date with industry trends, new features, and best practices so you can help customers optimize their use of Chainguard.
  • Training & Education: Collaborate with customers and our Edu team to ensure customers are educated on product features, best practices, and security principles.
  • Account Management: Develop relationships with multiple levels of customer stakeholders from technicians to CISOs. Work closely with sales teams to identify the best path to renew and expand customers while minimizing churn risks.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years experience in enterprise, customer facing roles collaborating with both technical and business teams - Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management or a combination of those plus Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Support.
  • Relevant domain knowledge of one or more of the following: Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security infrastructure, containers, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle.
  • This is a strategic and proactive role, our expectation is that this person will take full ownership of their customer portfolio and act with a high level of autonomy. This includes making key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; deciding when to include our executive team or c-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and advocating to internal teams including sales, product, engineering, etc.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be often build entirely new process or practices to ensure we best serve customers.
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to continuous personal and professional development, actively seeking opportunities to enhance skills, expand knowledge, and advance within their career and field.
  • Driven, high emotional intelligence, and strong priority management skills

Strongly Preferred:

  • Previous early-stage startup experience
  • Passion for technology & cybersecurity
  • Relevant hands-on technical experience, in one or more of the following domains: cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, Linux, Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security, security infrastructure, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Als Strategy Manager arbeitest du an den Fragen, die die Entwicklung unseres digitalen Brokerage-Angebots prägen. Du analysierst Märkte und Geschäftsmodelle, hinterfragst Annahmen und schaffst belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Geschäftsleitung.
