Du untersuchst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und leitest mögliche strategische Investitionsbedarfe ab.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen, um Dich in anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten einzubringen. Als Teil unseres Teams kannst Du schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wirklich etwas bewegen wollen und als starkes Team zusammenhalten. cbs ist der Ort, an dem Experten bleiben wollen.

 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Activist PMO Teams suchen wir ab sofort an den angegebenen Standorten einen (Senior) Consultant SAP SLT PMO (m/w/d). 

Der Bereich System Landscape Transformation (SLT) der cbs ist eine der tragenden Säulen unseres Beratungs- und Produktangebotes. Dabei bietet cbs einen ganzheitlichen Transformationsansatz – von der Strategieableitung über die Prozessdefinition bis hin zur Implementierung und Transformation liefern wir alles aus einer Hand. Als (Senior) Consultant im SLT PMO steuerst und strukturierst Du Selective-Data-Transition- und Migrationsvorhaben aus Projektmanagementsicht. Du unterstützt entweder die Projektleitung eines eigenständigen Transformationsprojekts oder übernimmst in großen Programmen die PMO-Verantwortung innerhalb der Datenmigration. Du verbindest Verständnis der Migrationslogik mit proaktiver Projektsteuerung und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheidungen und Abhängigkeiten transparent, termingerecht und nachvollziehbar geliefert werden.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Planung, Steuerung und Koordination von nationalen und internationalen SAP Transformations- und Datenmigrationsprojekten

  • Übernahme der methodischen Steuerung des SLT- bzw. Migrationsstreams entlang von Projektplanung, Meilensteinen und Quality Gates

  • Strukturierung und Nachverfolgung von Arbeitspaketen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Entscheidungsprozessen

  • Sicherstellung von Transparenz über Projektfortschritt, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und kritische Entscheidungen

  • Proaktive Unterstützung der Projektleitung und des Activist PMO bei Planung, Controlling, Reporting und Stakeholdermanagement

  • Vorbereitung und Moderation von Workshops und Projektmeetings auf verschiedenen Ebenen

  • Verantwortung für zentrale PMO sowie operative Projektleitungsthemen mit hoher Eigenständigkeit und ausgeprägtem Ownership-Gedanken

About GENUINE

GENUINE is Europe’s leading TikTok Shop agency, and we’re right in the middle of the social commerce revolution. We don’t just make content. We build shopping experiences that sell, at the speed of a viral trend. We’re growing fast, and so does our Finance & Operations team.

The Mission

Behind every viral LIVE and every creator campaign, a lot of money moves: platform fees, creator commissions, client payouts. You’ll help keep all of it clean, on time and under control. You’ll see how a hypergrowth agency really runs, and you’ll learn more in a few months than in most full-time jobs.

What You’ll Do

  • Follow the money: Own the monthly reconciliation of TikTok Shop settlements, fees and affiliate commissions against our records, and close every gap.

  • Run creator payouts: Manage the payout process end to end, from checking invoices to making sure everyone gets paid correctly and on time.

  • Automate the boring stuff: Drive the setup of tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software, and improve our processes as we scale.

  • Background: You’ve finished a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Business Informatics or something similar.

  • Language: You speak fluent English. German is nice to have, but you don’t need it.

Why us?

  • Real ownership from day one: You’ll work directly with the Finance & Operations Manager and the Managing Director, and own your own area.

  • Room to grow: As we scale, so does your role. There’s a clear path to more responsibility in Finance & Operations.

CTO Cofounder - PreSeed PropTech Berlin
jobs.description:
CTO Cofounder - PreSeed PropTech Berlin

Founders Factory × Nua Materials

Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory baut und finanziert gemeinsam mit außergewöhnlichen Gründer:innen und führenden Unternehmen neue Start-ups; unser Gründerteam verfügt über eigene Exit-/IPO-Erfahrung, und unsere mehr als 300 Portfoliounternehmen haben seit 2015 über 900 Mio. USD an Anschlussfinanzierung eingeworben.

Für Nua Materials suchen wir eine:n technische:n Co-Founder & CTO, der oder die gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Gründer aus einem validierten Konzept ein skalierbares Produkt und Unternehmen aufbaut.

Die Chance

Neuartige und nachhaltige Baustoffe gibt es längst, doch viele schaffen den Weg in reale Bauprojekte nur langsam. Für Bauunternehmen, Wohnungsunternehmen und Projektentwickler sind Informationen und Nachweise fragmentiert, Produkte schwer vergleichbar und neue Materialien mit zusätzlichen technischen, wirtschaftlichen und organisatorischen Risiken verbunden. Gleichzeitig steigt der regulatorische Druck: Wesentliche Teile der neuen EU-Bauprodukteverordnung gelten seit 2026, der Digitale Produktpass für Bauprodukte kommt.

Viele bestehende Lösungen setzen bei Dokumentation, Nachweisen und Zertifizierung an – nicht bei der eigentlichen Auswahl- und Kaufentscheidung. Genau dort setzt Nua Materials an. Ein zentraler Baustein ist der Nua Score, der bereits in einer ersten Version vorliegt. Bisherige Gespräche mit Herstellern, Bauunternehmen, Projektentwicklern und Gebäudeeigentümern bestätigen den Bedarf und zeigen Interesse an Pilotprojekten.

Was du aufbauen wirst

Als Co-Founder & CTO verantwortest du in der frühen Phase Produkt und Technologie.

  • Du definierst mit Nutzer:innen die entscheidenden Abläufe und baust den ersten nutzbaren Prototypen.

  • Du entwickelst den Nua Score weiter und baust eine robuste Daten- und Systemarchitektur für unterschiedliche externe Datenquellen.

  • Du entscheidest, was jetzt gebaut, später ergänzt oder automatisiert werden sollte – und was bewusst nicht ins Produkt gehört.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit ersten Kund:innen und Partnern und baust später ein kleines Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam auf.

Die ersten Monate sind sehr operativ: Wir suchen eine:n technische:n Gründer:in, der oder die selbst baut und Produktentscheidungen mitträgt.

Wen wir suchen

  • Produktentwicklung: Du kannst aus einem noch unscharfen Kundenproblem einen klaren, testbaren Produktansatz entwickeln und technisch umsetzen.

  • Datenbasierte Produkte: Du hast Erfahrung mit datengetriebenen Plattformen, Bewertungs- oder Vergleichssystemen und kannst konkrete Fehlerquellen, Datenqualitätsprobleme und Validierungsentscheidungen beschreiben.

  • Technische Breite: Du bist stark in Backend und Datenarchitektur und kommst im Frontend weit genug, um frühe Produktversionen selbst auszuliefern.

  • Vertrauen im B2B: Du baust nachvollziehbare Systeme, die bei risikoaversen Unternehmenskunden, langen Entscheidungswegen und hohen Nachweisanforderungen bestehen.

  • Gründermentalität und Marktverständnis: Du hast gegründet, warst eine:r der ersten technischen Mitarbeiter:innen eines Start-ups oder hast vergleichbare Verantwortung übernommen. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, professionelles Englisch und Erfahrung im DACH-Markt sind wichtig.

Besonders interessant, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung in Construction Tech oder PropTech

  • Hintergrund in Bauingenieurwesen oder Materialwissenschaften, idealerweise mit LCA-/EPD-Erfahrung

  • Erfahrung mit Vergleichsplattformen oder Marktplätzen

Was wir bieten

  • Kapital und Gründerfinanzierung für die Aufbauphase

  • Enge Unterstützung durch Founders Factory in Produkt, Daten, Wachstum, Finanzierung, Recht und Personal – auf Basis bestehender Markt-, Kunden- und Produktarbeit

  • Zugang zu ersten potenziellen Kund:innen und Partnern in Bau- und Wohnungswirtschaft sowie zu unserem internationalen Netzwerk



-------------------
In English:

Founders Factory × Nua Materials

Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory builds and funds new startups together with exceptional founders and leading companies. Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding.

For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept.

The opportunity

New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way.

Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. A core component is the Nua Score, which already exists in an initial version. Conversations with manufacturers, construction companies, developers and asset owners have confirmed the need and shown interest in pilots.

What you will build

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will own product and technology in the early stage.

  • Define the critical workflows with users and build the first usable product.

  • Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources.

  • Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product.

  • Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time.

The first months will be highly hands-on: we are looking for a technical founder who builds personally and helps shape the product, not a CTO who starts by delegating.

Who we are looking for

  • Product development: You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a clear, testable product approach and build it.

  • Data-driven products: You have experience with data-heavy platforms, scoring or comparison systems and can talk concretely about failure modes, data-quality issues and validation decisions you have encountered.

  • Technical range: You are strong in backend and data architecture and capable enough on the frontend to ship early product versions yourself.

  • Trust in B2B: You build transparent, credible systems that can stand up to risk-sensitive enterprise customers, long decision cycles and demanding evidence requirements.

  • Founder mindset and market understanding: You have founded before, were one of the first technical hires at a startup, or have taken on comparable ownership. Business-fluent German, professional English and experience in the DACH market are important.

Especially relevant, but not required

  • Experience in ConTech or PropTech

  • Background in civil engineering or materials science, ideally with LCA/EPD experience

  • Experience with comparison platforms or marketplaces

What we offer

  • Capital and founder funding for the build phase

  • Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, data, growth, fundraising, legal, finance and talent — building on existing market, customer and product work

  • Access to early prospective customers and partners across construction and housing, as well as our international network

jobs.title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
jobs.description:
Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll manage and grow a large portfolio of fleet business, using data and AI to assess risk and tailor cover to each client. You’ll help us move into new segments, including emerging mobility, as we build one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. You’ll report to our Head of Motor Underwriting.

You’ll work closely with brokers, mentor junior underwriters and help shape our products, wording and processes. AI is part of the underwriting process itself: you’ll use it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, leaving your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Manage and develop a large portfolio of motor fleet business and contribute strongly to team targets.

  • Build strong, supportive relationships with brokers.

  • Help unlock growth in new market segments, including emerging mobility.

  • Collate and analyse portfolio data so our Head of Motor Underwriting can track performance.

  • Improve how we gather risk information from clients, so quoting and onboarding run smoothly for clients and brokers.

  • Spot where our policy wording and cover can improve, and raise it with our Head of Motor Underwriting.

  • Train and develop people in the Underwriting and Operations teams, and spread underwriting knowledge across Flock.

  • Use AI to extract and check risk information and speed up quoting, keeping your own judgement on every decision.

 

What you’ll need

  • Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance.

  • A track record of building strong broker relationships.

  • Confidence working with data to monitor and analyse a portfolio.

  • Up-to-date knowledge of the motor fleet market and the curiosity to keep up as it changes.

  • Experience training or mentoring others.

  • Comfortable using AI in your underwriting work, and curious about where else it can help.

Nice to have: experience with large corporate customers, ACII (qualified or working towards it), or working with product teams to get process and customer journey improvements onto the roadmap.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

jobs.description:
Product Owner (H/F/N)

Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. 

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD 

Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle.

A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la  roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe 

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

Product at Lemrock has been driven by the founders so far. As our first Product Manager, you'll work directly with the founders and our CTO to shape the product vision, own a core part of the product end to end, and build the practice that takes us from idea to shipped.

You'll start by owning the brand-facing product, and your scope will grow fast from there.

Your mission

  • Shape the vision: bring your own conviction to the product strategy with the founders, from what we bet on next to what we stop doing.

  • Own the roadmap end to end: turn strategy into a living, prioritized roadmap, and decide what we don't build so the team stays on the highest-impact work.

  • Ship with the team: work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to scope, prototype, and ship weekly, not quarterly.

  • 3 to 8 years in product, at least part of it at a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early or first PM. You've taken something from a vague problem to a shipped, used feature, and owned its results.

  • A generalist comfortable owning the messy middle: discovery one hour, scoping with engineers the next, writing the launch note after that.

Why join us

Data Migration Project Manager

À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

  • Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

  • Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

  • Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

  • Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

Comprendre & structurer la data

  • Analyser et structurer les données sources du client

  • Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra

  • Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

  • Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

  • Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

  • Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

Collaborer avec les équipes Dastra

Tu travailles notamment avec :

  • les Sales, en avant-vente, pour apporter l’expertise Data Migration nécessaire au cadrage du projet et rassurer les prospects

  • les équipes Tech, sur les problématiques d'intégration et de fonctionnement de la plateforme ; 

  • les Privacy Success Managers, pour assurer une transition fluide après la migration et transmettre les enjeux et règles métier du client. 

Le profil recherché

  • Minimum 2/3 d'expérience en gestion de projets migration clients (implémentation, migration, intégration ou transformation de données)

  • Une expérience indispensable en gestion multiprojet et multiclient, idéalement en cabinet de conseil, ESN ou environnement SaaS 

  • Une connaissance des enjeux RGPD / Privacy et du métier de DPO, acquise dans un contexte professionnel

  • Une bonne culture IT & data : mapping, structuration de données, logique de scripts, compréhension des flux et architectures 

  • Une capacité à prendre rapidement en main un nouvel outil et à comprendre son fonctionnement

  • À l'aise pour conseiller, challenger et vulgariser auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et métier 

  • Anglais C2 indispensable 

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu es curieux·se, autonome et débrouillard·e : face à un nouvel outil ou une problématique que tu ne connais pas, tu cherches, tu comprends et tu proposes.

Tu apprécies autant comprendre comment fonctionne une plateforme que piloter un projet et accompagner un client jusqu'à sa réussite.

Tu as, à minima, une expérience auprès de DPO, équipes Privacy/Compliance ou sur un logiciel GRC/Privacy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Dastra ?

jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Healthcare AI

Position: Software Engineer - Healthcare AI
Job Type: Full-Time
Start Date: By agreement
Location: Zürich - hybrid, with most working days in the office
Language: English; German is a plus

About the Role

At Enzian Labs, we believe technology can make healthcare work better for everyone - from patients and clinicians to the people operating complex healthcare systems. We build software and AI solutions that turn fragmented information and difficult workflows into useful, reliable products.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to improve and extend our existing healthcare products. Your initial work will focus on data pipelines, and integrations, including workflows that turn healthcare documents into usable data. As our products evolve, you will contribute to new projects, including web or mobile applications.

You will develop AI-enabled workflows that transform complex healthcare data into dependable, usable systems. You will work closely with our technical lead and product stakeholders, owning substantial parts of implementation from initial design through production deployment.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an experienced engineer who enjoys data-intensive systems, pragmatic architecture, and solving meaningful problems in healthcare, while embracing the entrepreneurial spirit of a growing start-up.

What you’ll do

  • Build Full-Stack applications to enable operation workflows for clinician and healthcare staff.

  • Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that support healthcare workflows.

  • Develop and improve pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and export structured and unstructured data.

  • Integrate AI capabilities where they help solve a product problem, with appropriate evaluation, validation, and failure handling.

  • Work with product stakeholders to clarify requirements, make practical trade-offs, and deliver features that address user needs.

  • Build with care for sensitive healthcare data, including privacy, access control, and auditability.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, with examples of features or systems you’ve owned through production.

  • Practical experience with backend services, APIs, and relational databases, including work that involved processing or validating data.

  • Sound engineering judgment around testing, maintainability, security, and diagnosing production issues.

  • Comfort working through ambiguous requirements and learning new tools or parts of the stack as projects evolve.

Experience that would be helpful

  • Building or operating software on GCP or another major cloud platform.

  • Working in Healthcare or another environment that handles sensitive data.

  • Experienced with EU MDR or similar medical certifications.

  • Building user-facing features for web or mobile applications.

  • German is a plus for our client interactions.

Engagement Details

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, with most working days spent together in the office.

You will join a small team where engineers remain close to product decisions and the real-world impact of their work. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team or act as the technical lead.

  • Zelfstandig valideren en analyseren van data om de kwaliteitsstandaarden te garanderen. Resultaten van validaties nauwkeurig rapporteren aan klanten en data issues oplossen.

  • Het coördineren van het proces van data-aanlevering en -validatie, samen met andere betrokken collega’s.

Wat ga je doen?

Senior Customer Success Manager

Heel werkend Nederland op de fiets! Dat is de krachtige missie van Lease a Bike, waar we ons dagelijks vol passie voor inzetten. Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager.

In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Dit doe je natuurlijk niet alleen: je werkt nauw samen in een gedreven team van 6 collega’s.

Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager

Als Senior Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers.

Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen!

Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat.


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement;

  • Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk;

  • Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift;

Wat bieden wij? 

Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450. 

  • 8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering;

  • Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage;

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist;

  • Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen;

  • Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage;

  • Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken;

  • Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt.

Over de organisatie

Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)!

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA

Horizon3.ai is seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Customer Marketing Manager to build engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and advocacy across our EMEA customer base. You will create programs that help customers realize more value from Horizon3, strengthen customer relationships, and turn successful outcomes into credible customer proof.

This role brings together customer lifecycle marketing and customer advocacy. You will develop regional customer communications and campaigns while building a repeatable advocacy engine across customer stories, references, third-party reviews, speakers, and other strategic opportunities. You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, and the broader Marketing team to turn customer needs and business priorities into useful, measurable programs.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic planner and a hands-on operator. You can build trust with customers, coordinate complex projects across teams and markets, use data to improve programs, and make it straightforward for customers to participate.

What you will do

Customer lifecycle marketing

  • Plan and execute customer marketing programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal support, and expansion.

  • Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences.

  • Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Develop proactive re-engagement programs for at-risk or under-engaged accounts using customer health, product usage, support, engagement, and renewal signals.

  • Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to translate customer feedback into product communications, release messaging, educational content, and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with customer-centric messaging, adoption resources, executive business review materials, playbooks, and clear follow-up paths.

Customer advocacy and proof

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events.

  • Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams.

  • Create and manage a practical customer reference program that supports sales opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic marketing needs. Maintain an organized reference pool and manage requests from intake and matching through scheduling, follow-up, and recognition.

  • Own day-to-day Peerbound administration and adoption, including customer profiles, advocacy requests, reference activity, permissions, and reporting. Help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success use the platform consistently and make fuller use of its capabilities.

  • Develop and execute a focused third-party review strategy across relevant platforms, such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights. Coordinate authentic customer outreach and track review volume, ratings, sentiment, category placement, competitor positioning, and progress against award criteria.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of customer speakers for webinars, user groups, events, panels, and other marketing programs. Confirm speakers early enough to include them in event promotions, landing pages, emails, and social campaigns, and manage briefing, preparation, logistics, approvals, and follow-up.

  • Own the customer invitation process for Customer Advisory Board opportunities and support customer recruitment for analyst interviews, research, awards, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Work with Content, Product Marketing, Social, Events, Communications, Analyst Relations, and Creative to elevate customers alongside the Horizon3.ai brand and turn customer outcomes into reusable marketing assets.

Program operations and measurement

  • Build annual and quarterly customer marketing plans for EMEA, manage budgets and resources, and lead cross-functional execution.

  • Work with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations to improve segmentation, data quality, trigger detection, nurture, automation, attribution, and reporting.

  • Establish dashboards and operating rhythms that connect program engagement to adoption, customer advocacy, renewal health, retention, expansion pipeline, and influenced revenue.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, identify opportunities to improve, and iterate on program strategy, messaging, and execution.

  • Communicate timelines, owners, status, risks, and next steps clearly across teams. Create practical templates, trackers, and workflows that make customer marketing easier to execute and scale.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, customer advocacy, customer success enablement, or a related discipline.

  • Experience building customer journeys and programs across adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, or advocacy.

  • A track record of managing customer stories, references, reviews, speakers, or other advocacy programs, ideally alongside lifecycle marketing responsibilities.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

  • Strong project management and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines across teams and markets.

  • Analytical and operational skills, including the ability to connect customer behavior and program performance to business outcomes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to represent customer perspectives accurately and authentically.

  • Familiarity with customer advocacy, reference, review, CRM, or marketing automation platforms. Peerbound experience is a plus.

  • Understanding of B2B SaaS or cybersecurity customer environments is a plus.

  • Ability to work effectively across EMEA markets and time zones. Additional language skills are a plus.

How success is measured

  • Lifecycle program engagement and contribution to customer adoption, retention, renewal health, and expansion.

  • Growth and health of the EMEA customer advocate and reference pool, including references fulfilled and customer participation.

  • Customer proof produced, including case studies, videos, quotes, approved logos, and social or event participation.

  • Customer speakers confirmed in time to support event and webinar promotion.

  • Peerbound adoption, data quality, and program activity.

  • Review volume, ratings, sentiment, and progress against award criteria.

  • Customer experience and internal stakeholder satisfaction.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Technical Support Specialist

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Technical Support Specialists to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities.

You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases. Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter.
  • Build and own AI quality. Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain.
  • Synthesize and partner with Product/Eng. Produce formal weekly and monthly insights, participate in roadmap conversations with Product Development teams, and mentor Associates on their build and synthesis work.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • Shipped 3–5 AI solutions
  • A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume
  • Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster
  • You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it.
  • You build with AI to make yourself and the teammates around you faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and turning one-off builds into reusable patterns Associates can run with.
  • Mentors Associate teammates on AI builds and pattern synthesis

Professional Qualifications

  • 0-4+ years of relevant experience inSupport, Implementation, CS Ops, embedded data analyst, or AI/automation tinkerer in any field.
  • A concrete portfolio of things you've built or shipped: prompt-engineered systems, dashboards, automations — with evidence of outcomes
  • Strong customer-facing communication and trust-building skills
  • Pattern recognition and synthesis muscle
  • AI-native default. Reaches for AI tools first, treats ambiguity as the work rather than a blocker, and wants to learn how to configure and supervise these systems — not just use them
  • A deep desire to drive results for our customers, with high ownership over the outcomes you own
  • Curiosity and natural problem-solving instincts
  • An instinct to raise the bar for the teammates around you — teaching others to build and synthesize, not just modeling it yourself

Show us your work

Along with your application, in a cover letter send us:

  1. 2–3 things you've built or shipped that changed a metric or outcome — what you made, who it was for, why did you need to do it, and what changed.
  2. A short story about a time your analysis or insight changed a decision someone else made.

Salary range: $52,500 - 75,000 CAD

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Operators
jobs.description:
Account Executive - Operators

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

About Operators at MaintainX

Machine operators, line workers, and other frontline crews far outnumber maintenance technicians on most plant floors, and they touch the equipment every shift. The MaintainX operator module puts them on the same platform as maintenance.

The Account Executive – Operators will be dedicated to operator sales, helping manufacturers bring their whole frontline workforce onto MaintainX.

Role Overview

As an Account Executive – Operators, you will own the sales motion for expanding MaintainX to operators, which is an important area of growth and already has meaningful revenue. You will join deals owned by our Account Executives, Account Managers and Account Directors to find the frontline workforce inside each customer, size it, build the business case, and close.

You will work with plant and operations leaders to expand MaintainX across their sites.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product and Marketing, and what you hear in the field will shape how we sell and build for operators. This is a “Co-Sell” position, working with MaintainX Sellers and working with the Senior Manager, New Product Sales to build out the Operator sales motion playbook.

What You'll Do

Own the Operators sales motion

  • Run the operator side of deals alongside the account owner: discovery, seat sizing, business case, demos, trials, pricing, and close.

  • Follow up quickly on leads and turn them into qualified pipeline.

  • Partner with Account Managers, Account Directors and CSMs on prospecting to find operator expansion in existing customers, and with AEs to add operators to new deals.

Deeply understand the plant floor

  • Engage plant, operations, EHS and maintenance leaders to learn where opportunities exist to add operators to MaintainX.

  • Map customer use cases to MaintainX, including TPM and autonomous maintenance, pre-use inspections, quality checks, and problem reporting.

  • Quantify impact in downtime and micro-stoppages avoided, scrap and rework reduced, paperwork hours saved, and safety gains.

Run trials and pilots that prove value

  • Structure trials and pilots that prove value fast and set up a broader rollout.

  • Work with Solutions Consultants, CSMs and Implementation to define success criteria, timelines, and rollout plans.

  • Translate trial results into clear business outcomes and ROI for plant and operations leadership.

Tell a differentiated story

  • Deliver tailored demos and executive presentations that show operators and maintenance working in one system.

  • Position MaintainX against paper, standalone checklist apps and other vendors.

  • Share field feedback and competitive insights with Product and Marketing to sharpen messaging and inform the operator roadmap.

Operate with excellence

  • Keep operator opportunities and forecasts clean and current in Salesforce.

  • Hand off cleanly to Implementation and Customer Success so operators are live soon after the deal closes.

  • Help shape the Operators sales playbook: coach account teams on operator discovery, pricing and objection handling, and bring what works back to sales enablement.

About You

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including selling into manufacturing, logistics, food & beverage or other asset-intensive environments.

  • Hustle mentality - “If you lose a day, you lost a week. If you lose a week you lost the month. If you lose a month, you lost the quarter.”

  • A track record of beating quota, ideally including expansion deals in existing accounts.

  • Strong value selling and discovery skills, especially sizing a frontline workforce and building an ROI case around downtime, quality, labor and safety.

  • Comfortable as an overlay: you join deals other sellers own, add value from the first call, and help the MaintainX sales team win.

  • Clear, confident presenter to plant managers and operations executives, comfortable running a live demo on a phone.

  • Highly organized, with strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline.

  • You like building something new: testing plays, keeping what works, and helping write the playbook as it takes shape.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.title: Field Marketing and Events Manager
jobs.description:
Field Marketing and Events Manager

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As the Field Marketing & Events Manager, you own Rithum’s field marketing and events program across assigned regions and play a defined role in executing the events calendar. You design and deliver a portfolio that spans client conferences, industry trade shows, internal company gatherings, executive dinners, and multi-city roadshows. You are accountable for the demand those programs generate, including leads, pipeline, and client engagement, and for the localized marketing strategy that connects them to Rithum’s business objectives within assigned regions. Working with senior marketing leadership and regional sales, you define what success looks like for field marketing, build the processes that make strong events repeatable, and deliver experiences that raise Rithum’s brand visibility with clients and industry leaders.

At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Regional Strategy & Events Planning

  • Define and execute the field events plan within assigned regions, setting clear objectives and measurable goals for brand visibility and business impact
  • Partner with field marketing and sales leadership to plan and execute events within the global field plan, with clear ownership agreed for each event
  • Develop and execute localized marketing strategies that drive demand, generate leads, and accelerate the sales pipeline across markets within assigned regions

Event Delivery & Execution

  • Plan and execute a broad range of events, from high-touch executive dinners to mid-scale multi-city roadshows, each with defined objectives, tracking, and measurement
  • Lead end-to-end event execution, including budgeting, pre- and post-event marketing, on-site and offsite experience and logistics, vendor management, and post-event analysis
  • Coordinate across time zones with sales, field, and event vendors so that execution standards, timelines, and handoffs are consistent between regions

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Track event performance against attendance, leads generated, opportunities and pipeline generated, and client feedback, and present actionable insight to stakeholders
  • Build repeatable processes, templates, and post-event review practices that deliver consistent results across all regions and calendars, not just through individual effort, and apply a single measurement standard throughout

AI-Enabled Practice

  • Use AI to improve the quality of event planning and performance decisions, not only the speed of delivery, surfacing alternatives and stress-testing assumptions before committing budget
  • Model and share effective AI practices with the wider marketing team, and be clear about what must be verified before AI-assisted material reaches clients or partners

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across sales, marketing, content, product, and client success, as well as external partners, to deliver seamless events aligned with business goals
  • Leverage company websites, online content, industry trends, and emerging technologies to enhance the client experience and event effectiveness

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in field or corporate events marketing within an enterprise B2B software or e-commerce organization, with experience across multiple regions and markets
  • Previous experience in events and field marketing within the e-commerce sector, engaging e-commerce audiences
  • Demonstrated experience leading and executing large industry events, including Shoptalk, NRF, eTail
  • Strong working knowledge of the B2B technology ecosystem and of regional differences in event strategy, audience engagement, and execution
  • Successful ownership and management of event budgets across varying scales and complexity
  • Proven experience planning and executing events with clearly defined budgets, objectives, and measurable KPIs, pre- and post-event
  • Working knowledge of core marketing metrics and their application in measuring event success and field marketing impact
  • Experience with event management tools and platforms such as Asana, Marketo, Cvent, Salesforce, HubSpot, and virtual event platforms
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent events to deadline across more than one market and time zone
  • Experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders, including Sales and Client Success, to align marketing initiatives with broader business objectives
  • Ability to travel globally on a regular basis for events, with authorization to work and travel internationally
  • Experience using AI tools to improve marketing or events work, including planning, analysis, content development, and reporting, with verification of output before it reaches clients or partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years in field or corporate events management within B2B technology, software, or e-commerce
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
  • Previous experience in events and field marketing within the e-commerce sector, engaging e-commerce audiences
  • Experience supporting events in both EMEA and North America across diverse industries and market segments
  • Experience working directly with sales to drive measurable results
  • London-based, with the ability to travel to the office, as this role collaborates closely with the regional sales team and a global field marketing team

Travel Required

25% - 40%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

IT-Administrator:in (Microsoft 365 & Intune) für Non-Profits (m/w/d)

Wir sind das Rückgrat einiger Non-Profit-Organisationen in Berlin. Wir bauen verlässliche und sichere IT-Lösungen, damit sich Vereine, Stiftungen und NGOs auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können: ihre Mission. Bei uns baust du IT, die trägt – statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

Unsere Kund:innen sind Organisationen wie das Deutsche Kinderhilfswerk, die Technologiestiftung Berlin oder die Weltbank Group – Menschen, die mit ihrer Arbeit etwas verändern. Und du sorgst dafür, dass ihre IT verlässlich funktioniert.

Deine Rolle

Du bist bei uns die Person für Microsoft 365 und Intune. Du entscheidest, wie ein Tenant aufgesetzt ist, welche Richtlinien für Konten und Geräte gelten und wie die Daten vom alten Fileserver sauber in SharePoint landen. Bevor bei Kund:innen etwas umgebaut wird, planst du es – von der Bestandsaufnahme über das Zielbild bis zum Cut-over – und setzt es anschließend mit dem Team um. Unser IT-Support arbeitet nach deinen Standards und spiegelt dir, was im Alltag hakt.

Was du bei uns machst

Microsoft 365 & Entra ID

  • Tenants aufsetzen und aufräumen: Rollen, Lizenzen, Gruppen, Gastzugriffe und klare Namenskonventionen

  • Exchange Online betreuen: Postfächer, Verteiler, Mail-Flow, Spam- und Phishing-Schutz, SPF, DKIM und DMARC

  • SharePoint und Teams so strukturieren, dass Seiten, Bibliotheken und Berechtigungen auch in zwei Jahren noch verständlich sind

  • Identitäten absichern: MFA, Conditional Access, Notfallkonten und Rechtekonzepte in Entra ID

Intune & Endgeräte

  • Windows-Geräte über Intune verwalten: Konfigurations- und Compliance-Richtlinien, Updates und App-Rollouts

  • Geräte-Rollouts und Windows-11-Umstellungen planen und durchziehen, gern mit Autopilot

  • Microsoft Defender for Business einrichten und Meldungen bewerten

  • Apple-Geräte einbinden, wo Kund:innen gemischt arbeiten, über Intune und Apple Business Manager

Migrationen & Projekte

  • Bestandsaufnahmen bei Kund:innen durchführen und daraus ein Zielbild entwickeln: Wo soll die IT in ein bis zwei Jahren stehen?

  • Umzüge planen und umsetzen: vom Fileserver nach SharePoint, von Google Workspace zu Microsoft 365, von Tenant zu Tenant oder raus aus dem lokalen Active Directory

  • Den Plan selbst mit umsetzen: Testlauf, Cut-over am Wochenende, Rückfallebene und Nachbetreuung der Nutzer:innen

  • Konzepte so aufschreiben, dass Geschäftsführung und Vorstand entscheiden können: mit Varianten, Kosten und Risiken

  • Aufwände realistisch schätzen und Angebote gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung vorbereiten

Copilot, KI & Automatisierung

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot und andere KI-Tools bei Kund:innen einführen – mit aufgeräumten Berechtigungen, Vertraulichkeitsbezeichnungen und geklärtem Datenschutz

  • Wiederkehrendes automatisieren: PowerShell, Microsoft Graph oder Power Automate

Support & Schulung

  • Zweite Eskalationsstufe für alles rund um Microsoft 365 und Endgeräte – vor Ort in Berlin

  • Technische Entscheidungen verständlich begründen, auch gegenüber Geschäftsführungen ohne IT-Hintergrund

  • Kurze Security- und Anwendungsschulungen für Mitarbeitende unserer Kund:innen

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort: im Büro in Schöneberg und ab und an bei unseren Kund:innen in Berlin, dazu bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche.

  • Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration oder mindestens zwei Jahre Praxis in der Administration

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 auf Administrationsebene: Tenant-Struktur, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Intune: Richtlinien, Compliance, App-Rollouts – du definierst Standards, statt sie nur anzuwenden

  • Du denkst erst in Konzepten, dann in Klicks: Du hast schon eine Microsoft-365-Migration oder ein größeres Geräte-Rollout selbst geplant und durchgezogen und kannst das verständlich aufschreiben

  • Verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit KI: Du nutzt KI-Tools gern und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse, bevor sie bei Kund:innen landen. Du führst kein Skript aus, das du nicht verstehst, und gibst Kundendaten nur in freigegebene Tools

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Du erklärst Technik klar, freundlich und mit Geduld

Nice to have

  • Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie MS-102, MD-102 oder SC-300

  • Erfahrung mit Autopilot, Defender for Business oder Microsoft Purview

  • Tenant-zu-Tenant-Migrationen oder das Ablösen von Entra ID Hybrid-Setups

  • Berührungspunkte mit Google Workspace oder Apple-Geräteverwaltung

  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft-Lizenzen für gemeinnützige Organisationen und Berührungspunkte mit Non-Profit, NGO oder Stiftung

Du fühlst dich eher in der ganzen Breite zu Hause, mit Netzwerk, Backup und Security? Dann schau dir auch unsere Stelle als IT-Administrator:in für Non-Profits an.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gehalt: 48.000 – 68.000 € brutto/Jahr (je nach Erfahrung)

  • Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche

  • Arbeit mit Sinn: du unterstützt Organisationen, die gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen

jobs.title: Scientist II - Molecular Biology
jobs.description:
Scientist II - Molecular Biology

About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

 

Core Responsibilities

Day to day responsibilities

  • Perform isolation and cryopreservation of cells from human blood samples

  • Perform single-cell RNA sequencing assays, ensure accurate sample identification, labelling, tracking and traceability throughout the sample processing workflow

  • Assess sample quality and suitability for downstream applications, escalating samples that do not meet predefined acceptance criteria

  • Ensure samples are processed, stored, and handled within specified timeframes and conditions to maintain sample integrity

  • Maintain accurate sample inventories and update relevant laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or sample tracking records

  • Monitor reagent and consumable stock levels, anticipate upcoming requirements, and communicate replenishment needs to the relevant team members

  • Ensure laboratory data and assay results are accurately recorded, reviewed, and stored in accordance with established procedures

  • Identify, document and escalate sample discrepancies, labelling errors, or deviations from established sample handling procedures

  • Perform investigation of unexpected assay results and contribute to identifying potential root causes and corrective actions

  • Maintain IMU lab quality control measures

  • Perform and assess routine equipment quality control checks

  • Monitor equipment performance and promptly escalate abnormal readings, equipment failures, or maintenance requirements

  • Involved with analysing, reporting and storing assay results

  • Establish priorities when involved in multiple projects and deliver on target

  • Maintain consistent and regular progress reporting to senior staff members and have effective lines of communication with all colleagues by being proactive with providing updates regarding progress and also voicing ideas, inputs and feedbacks

  • Communicate effectively across cross-functional teams

Supporting responsibilities

  • Perform assay optimisation and troubleshooting experiments

  • Participate in method verification, validation, or performance evaluation activities, as appropriate to the laboratory's quality framework

  • Provide technical and organisational support to the team and ensure that reagents are prepared, stored and used in an appropriate manner

  • Help with general laboratory maintenance including aliquoting, stock checking, receiving and storing of deliveries, day-to-day maintenance and cleaning of instruments and equipment

  • Coordinate sample shipment and receipt from our clients and partners

  • Contribute to highly collaborative research projects, working closely with colleagues

Continuous improvement and innovation of our practices

  • Identify and propose opportunities to improve laboratory workflows, sample processing efficiency, assay reproducibility, and resource utilisation

  • Support the development and implementation of laboratory automation workflows to improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability

  • Support the evaluation and implementation of new laboratory methods, reagents, equipment, and technologies

The above list of responsibilities may not be exhaustive, and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks and responsibilities as may reasonably be expected within the scope, purpose and grading of the post.

 

Team and Ways of Working

Lab team

  • Office based, 5 days a week

  • Integrate in the molecular biology team

  • Work closely with flow cytometry part sub team

 
 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Qualification Requirements

  • A minimum of BSc/MSc in biological science degree with relevant work experience

 

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Experience in molecular biology techniques including nucleic acid isolation, PCR, and next generation sequencing

  • Proven hands-on experience with single-cell transcriptomics assays (RNAseq essential), using platforms such as 10x, Parse, Rhapsody, or similar.

  • Familiar with working with blood and tissue samples

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills)

  • Experience designing experiments

  • Experience with automated systems

  • Experience using LIMS and ELN

  • Experience working with human biological samples and familiarity with Human Tissue Act (2004)

  • Knowledge of ISO 15189:2022 and ISO 13485

  • Background or interest in immunology, with a preference for candidates who have worked within drug discovery / development.

  • Experience working in biotech or pharma space

 

Key Competencies

  • Able to work flexible hours when necessary to accommodate sample delivery schedules and R&D experiments

  • Troubleshooting skills and ability to independently drive experiments to completion

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks to meet deadlines under pressure

  • Proactive/autonomous

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Excellent teamwork, communication, and self-motivation in a fast-paced biotech environment

  • Eager and open to learning new skills at the cutting edge of immunology

Why Join Us?

● Competitive salary and company bonus scheme

● Pension, health insurance, life assurance, and income protection

● Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture

● Strong opportunities for career development and progression

 
 
 

Compensation: £47K – £54K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Up to 15% bonus payable per annum
