jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer

Senior Software Engineer

 

Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week)

Experience Level: +5 years commercial software engineering experience

 

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that. Investa is the first FCA-regulated platform to offer completely free US share trading with no FX, no commission, and no other fees.

 

Our Traction So Far:

  • £3.5M+ raised in funding with 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • FCA-regulated and multi-award winning in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) & Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN)

  • Available on iOS and Android, scaling rapidly toward our next milestones of 10,000 and 100,000 active users

  • 8,000+ trades processed, 2,500+ early supporters rewarded, and 150+ 5-star reviews

 

Our Mission: To democratise options trading for UK investors

Our Vision: Think Options, Think Investa

 

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

 

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.

 

The Role

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch and we’re now looking for a high-impact Senior Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

You will have extensive commercial experience designing, building and maintaining systems used in critical services or those handling significant volumes of activity.

 

You will play a crucial role in building key parts of our platform and apps, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and security of our systems.

 

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex challenges and you excel in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

 

What the role involves

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders with zero middle-management red tape, you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

  • Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • System Design & Architectural Influence: Partnering directly with the CEO and Principal Engineers to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and systems you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.

  • Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and drive) meaningful code reviews.

  • System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship.

     

Your Background

  • Coding: You are a "doer." You love shipping code, crave the responsibility that comes with joining a founding team, and are comfortable driving tricky engineering problems forward with high autonomy and support from the team.

  • Adaptable & Impact-Driven: Technical Depth: You have +5 years experience in software engineering, specifically building and maintaining production-grade distributed systems. You are a flexible engineer who is excited to jump in wherever the business actually needs you most to solve interesting problems across the board. You are proficient in at least one or two modern languages (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, etc.) and have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You balance structural integrity with contextual relevance, ensuring we don't just build the "perfect" system, but the right system for our current needs.

  • Collaborative Spirit: You enjoy working in a tight-knit team, giving/receiving candid feedback, and contributing to a culture of shared learning.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You don’t just follow patterns; you understand why they exist. You can pick up new technologies or domains (like complex options Greeks) quickly, and you welcome a setup that actively forces you to grow into a much more versatile engineer.

On-call

  • All engineers at Investa are involved in providing support for our products. This involves responding to events outside of working hours and is a core part of the role of all engineers.

     

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

 

Compensation and Benefits

 

Financial Growth 💸

  • Base Salary: £85,000 – £105,000 per annum, commensurate with experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.25% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook Pro and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

     

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening with Talent Lead

  • Stage 2: Technical & Architectural Deep Dive

  • Stage 3: Coding/Systems Design Interview

  • Stage 4: Final Behavioural interview

  • Offer

     

Looking at both our Senior and Mid-Level roles?

Please choose the single position that best matches your current experience and apply once. Our hiring team cross-reviews all engineering applications, so if the other level turns out to be a better fit, we’ll automatically switch your application.

jobs.title: Sustainability data advisor, financial services
jobs.description:
Sustainability data advisor, financial services

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Leading financial institutions like Carlyle Group, KKR, Ares, and BBVA use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive portfolio decarbonization.

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically minded individual to join our Sustainability Data Advisory team in London, with a focus on financial institutions. You'll join a small team that operates like a startup within a startup at Watershed, working with some of the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, banks, and insurers to accelerate their sustainability strategies.

You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform. You'll help customers measure financed emissions and use insights from their footprint to inform reporting and decision-making.

You will:

  • Advise teams at the world's largest financial institutions. Work directly with customers to measure financed emissions and strengthen their sustainable finance programs, supporting portfolio decarbonization and reporting across frameworks including TCFD, SFDR, CSRD, and LP reporting.

  • Deliver services that accelerate customer success. Lead measurement sessions and provide specialized advisory to help customers set up measurements, improve data quality, and unlock value from Watershed's platform. Support customers through emissions verification when needed.

  • Collaborate with science, engineering, and product teams to apply innovative measurement solutions, interpret the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials (PCAF) standards, and help customers make informed choices about how to measure emissions across asset classes.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 4–6 years of experience in consulting, solutions engineering, another customer-facing role in sustainability. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them build world-class sustainability programs.

  • Have an understanding of PCAF methodology and experience applying it to financed emissions measurement.

  • Have experience working with financial institutions and understand how they use emissions to inform internal decision-making and sustainability strategies.

  • Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic, and efficient, and you thrive in a high-volume environment.

  • Think clearly about complex problems and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed.

  • Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup.

Fluency in multiple languages—English, French, German, or Spanish—is a nice to have.

This position requires working in person in our London office four days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Тoday, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management — a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

You'll own a product area end to end, including its legal and regulatory position. We're hiring across trading and execution (order routing, settlement, corporate actions), tax-efficient investing and pensions (ISAs, SIPPs and German pension accounts), crypto, and client accounts and payments (onboarding, client money, cards and FX). jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer

Everfield: Senior Data Engineer

The Company

Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth.

Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients.

Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia.

The Position

As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:

  • Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse

  • Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)

  • Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools

  • Further developing Lakehouse Lumen, our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users

  • Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders

You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality.

The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL.

For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving.

This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area.

Responsibilities

Adhere to the DevOps methodology by:

  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks.

  • Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git.

  • Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude.

  • Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control.

  • Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows.

  • Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users.

  • Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Hard Skills

Required:

  • 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer, and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields.

  • Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing.

  • Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics.

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema).

  • Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills)

  • Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization.

  • Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps.

Soft Skills

  • Independent Worker: Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals.

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context.

  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

  • Collaborative: Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions.

  • Quality-Focused: Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards.

  • Strategic Planner: Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation.

  • Purpose-Driven: Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives.

What’s in it for you?

  • Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization.

  • Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform.

  • Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies.

  • Long term career opportunities.

  • Working from home for up to 4 days per week.

  • Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany).

Continue the Conversation

Interested? We would love to hear from you!

Apply now with your CV, and if you are selected, our Talent Manager will contact you to schedule the first call and start our hiring process.

Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Accountant to own core parts of our month-end and year-end close. You'll report to the Assistant Controller and join a focused team supporting two US manufacturing labs, a set of international entities and rising transaction volume. We are looking for a self-starter with an operational mindset who can navigate complex accounting transactions, and find solutions to new accounting scenarios as they arise.

Dandy runs on physical operations: labs, materials, equipment, shipping and people across several countries. Each of these flows into the general ledger. We want an accountant who understands how operations show up in the books and works with upstream teams to get the data right the first time.

Your main areas: prepaid and accrued expenses, operating expense coding, intercompany and consolidation, general ledger maintenance and close procedures. You'll partner with Operations, Procurement, People and FP&A to find process gaps and close them.

What you'll do

  • Own prepaid, accrued expense and opex schedules, including professional fees, software and contractor spend.

  • Prepare and post journal entries for the monthly, quarterly and annual close, with clear support for estimates, allocations and accruals.

  • Book intercompany entries and support consolidation across our US and international entities. Work with Tax on quarterly transfer pricing entries.

  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts and resolve differences before close.

  • Prepare flux analysis and explain monthly results to the Assistant Controller and FP&A.

  • Trace coding errors back to source systems such as payroll, purchasing and billing, and work with system owners to fix them upstream.

  • Document processes, accounting policies and controls to support our annual audit.

  • Prepare audit support schedules and respond to auditor requests.

  • Automate manual close steps in NetSuite and related systems.

What We're Looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.

  • 3+ years as a Senior Accountant, or 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.

  • Experience in an operational business: manufacturing, distribution, healthcare services, logistics or multi-site operations.

  • Strong grasp of US GAAP, accruals, reconciliations and internal controls.

  • Advanced Excel skills and comfort with large data sets.

  • A track record of fixing root causes in upstream processes.

  • Clear, concise communication with accountants and non-accountants.

  • Strong organization, attention to detail and follow-through on tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and a willingness to ask questions.

Bonus points

  • Inventory, cost or manufacturing accounting experience.

  • Multi-entity and multi-currency accounting.

  • NetSuite experience.

Scientist - Patient Stratification, Biomarkers, Translational Genomics

Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders.

For example, a Scientist may:

  • Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies.

  • Cluster genetic variants by their effects on disease-relevant traits to reveal distinct biological mechanisms, and use partitioned polygenic scores to define patient subgroups that share underlying causal biology.

  • Discover and validate novel biomarkers from clinical or ‘omic data, and apply them to stratify patient populations in large biobanks or clinical trials.

To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others.

Who You Are

Essential:

  • Solid foundations in statistics (e.g., modelling, regression), genetics and molecular biology, and statistical programming (e.g., Python or R).

  • Experience using at least one of the following statistical genetics approaches: GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores.

Preferred:

  • Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records.

  • Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference.

  • Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding)

  • Experience building and running reproducible pipelines, e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow.

  • Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments, e.g., DNAnexus or Verily Workbench.

  • Experience with methods development within statistical genetics.

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Rotterdam - Als Manager Data-analyse Nieuwsmedia ben je een analytisch sterk en verantwoordelijk voor inhoudelijke inzichten binnen het cluster AD.nl en de 7 regiotitels, zoals De Stentor of De Gelderlander. Je realiseert duurzame digitale groei door de inzichten strategisch te verankeren in de dagelijkse werking van de redacties. Je fungeert als de onmisbare schakel tussen centrale teams en de lokale redacties. Je zit in het team Redactionele Inzichten & Groei (RI&G) en rapporteert aan de Director RI&G.

Wie zijn wij?
Wij zijn de afdeling Redactionele inzichten & groei (RI&G). Binnen de divisie Nieuwsmedia & Magazines zijn wij de rechterhand voor de hoofdredacties mbt inhoudelijke inzichten en strategie. Met data-analyses, actieplannen en implementaties realiseren we duurzame digitale groei op de redacties. Zo helpen we de redacties om redactionele en operationele kansen in één oogopslag te signaleren en bepalen we samen de digitale koers van onze nieuwsmerken. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Cluster-verantwoordelijkheid: Je beheert de roadmap voor het gehele cluster AD + regiotitels en bepaalt welke projecten en centrale data-innovaties prioriteit krijgen.

  • Team lead & Coaching: Je geeft direct leiding aan een team van 8 lokale analisten, coacht hen in hun rol als strategisch partner voor titels en bevordert de zelfredzaamheid van de redacties. Deze analisten werken op de verschillende redacties verspreid doorheen het land.

  • Strategisch filter: Je fungeert als de 'brug' en het filter voor ad-hoc vragen vanuit de redactie en distribueert deze efficiënt binnen het team om de focus op impact te bewaken.

  • Analytisch expert: Je voert zelfstandig complexe, zwaardere clusterbrede analyses en strategische deep-dives uit die specifiek voor het cluster zijn bedoeld.

  • Netwerkfunctie: Je stemt clusteroverstijgende prioriteiten af met het centrale team, de andere leads en de verschillende hoofdredacties binnen jouw cluster.

Wat maak jou de ideale kandidaat?

  • Je hebt een WO / HBO+ denkniveau en 5+ jaar ervaring in data-analyse en strategie mét grote affiniteit voor media.

  • Je beschikt over analytisch en strategisch meesterschap, waardoor je redactionele of operationele kansen signaleert en complexe datasets vertaalt naar een helder, strategisch verhaal.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het direct en indirect aansturen van een team en krijgt energie van coachend leiderschap om de effectieve samenwerking te bevorderen.

  • Je bent besluitvaardig en durft harde prioriteiten te stellen en keuzes richting hoofdredacties te verdedigen.

  • Je hebt een sterke communicatieve kracht en schakelt moeiteloos tussen de diepgaande taal van data-analisten en de strategische behoeften van hoofdredacties en directie.

  • Je bent hands-on en nog steeds zeer vaardig met analytische tools.

  • Jouw standplaats is Rotterdam en je bent bereid om te reizen naar de regionale titels van ADR (van Middelburg tot Enschede).

Wat krijg je van ons?
💰 Een salaris passend bij jouw werkervaring en expertise, met een indicatie tussen € 5.500 en € 7.000 bruto per maand.
📝 Een 36-urige werkweek.

🎓 Ruimte om je te ontwikkelen, zowel op de job als online via onze DPG Campus.
🎉 Mogelijkheid om je eigen culturele feestdagen af te stemmen.

Solliciteren, en dan?
Heb je interesse? Wil je eerst meer informatie? Neem dan gerust contact op met Julia van EL: Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken
Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen. 

We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega’s te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquizteam of een sportteam is. 

Ontdek wat wij je te bieden hebben. En, als je toch bezig bent, vind je ons ook op LinkedIn en Instagram.

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Senior Projectmanager

Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS.

  • Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code.

  • CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk.

  • Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken.

  • Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij.

  • Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen.

  • Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag.

  • Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie.

MEER WETEN?

jobs.title: ABM Specialist
jobs.description:
ABM Specialist

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on our Customer Growth Marketing team, inside the account-based marketing (ABM) program that drives site expansion within our existing Enterprise and Mid-Market customers.. You will run the campaigns that introduce MaintainX to new sites and departments, keeping the expansion pipeline growing as targets rise.

The role

You will own the execution behind our ABM programs, so we reach more of our named accounts with timely, relevant campaigns.

  • Run our paid ABM programs on LinkedIn and programmatic: build audiences from account lists and signals, shift budget and creative based on engagement, and test new channels as budget grows. Plan and launch coordinated campaigns across webinars, events, email, and direct mail, timed to account activity and Sales priorities, so Sales has a relevant touchpoint when an account shows buying signals.

  • Set up and QA campaigns in our ABM and marketing tools, and keep account and contact data clean so we reach the right people.

  • Write briefs for ads and landing pages for Creative and keep a refresh calendar, so no campaign goes stale.

  • Report on campaign results and bring your own ideas for one-to-few and one-to-one account plays, so we can go after more high-value accounts.

You will work closely with our Senior Manager, ABM, who sets strategy and signal design, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, Events, and Content. Within 6 to 12 months, you will run our paid programs independently, own your pipeline KPIs, and have designed account plays of your own.

About you

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with hands-on paid digital, ABM, or demand generation experience

  • Experience managing paid campaigns, ideally on LinkedIn and programmatic, and optimizing for pipeline quality rather than volume

  • A track record of executing multi-channel campaigns end to end, ideally ABM campaigns

  • Working knowledge of Outreach (or similar) and Salesforce

  • Strong project management across many campaigns and deadlines at once

  • Comfort pulling performance data, spotting trends, and explaining what they mean

  • Initiative and comfort with ambiguity: you do well in a high-growth environment where priorities pivot

Nice to have:

  • Experience with ABM or sales intelligence tools (UserGems, ZoomInfo, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense)

  • Experience with direct mail or other offline ABM tactics

  • Background in industrial or operations software

We offer

  • Work in the physical world. The accounts you target run factories, fleets, and facilities, and when our software works, their lines stay up.

  • A product the industry already loves. Customers who choose us renew and expand, so you are building on something that already wins.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. MaintainX is part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), which brings Autodesk’s global reach to the problem we were already solving.

  • An early seat. This program is scaling fast, and the account plays we have not had capacity to run are yours to design.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We hire for what you have shipped, not what your title was. You get autonomy and the trust to use it, and we expect you to bring ideas rather than wait to be asked. Priorities shift in a company growing this fast, and we say so openly.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Full-Time USA

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we’ve been focused on building an intuitive, reliable experience that empowers physicians to deliver better care to patients.

Elation is looking for a full-stack engineer with a deep understanding of web programming, design, and technical obstacles to join our application team focused on building and maintaining AI driven product experiences. As a member of the team you’ll be deeply involved in the system design, development, and maintenance of these products.

If you’re excited about building AI-powered tools that help doctors and patients, we want to hear from you — even if you don’t check every box below!

What You’ll Do in Your First 60 Days

  • Partner with Product and UX to scope and design at least one new capability
  • Get familiar with our stack (Python, MySQL, React, AWS) and AI integration patterns
  • Participate in code reviews and share knowledge with the team

  • You’re owning significant features end-to-end, from design through deployment
  • You’re helping shape technical direction for AI-native product experiences
  • You’re mentoring other engineers and collaborating to improve team practices
  • You’ve built strong partnerships with support and infrastructure to help triage bugs and quickly resolve production issues
  • The AI features you’ve built are measurably improving physician and patient outcomes

How We Work

A typical team at Elation includes 3–5 engineers, an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and QA working together on a specific product area. Engineers have autonomy over technical implementation decisions while partnering with Product on feature scope and priorities. You’ll own features end-to-end — from architecture and design through deployment and production support.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience building APIs using modern backend technologies
  • Ability to communicate complex technical problems clearly to both technical and non-technical partners
  • Track record of delivering high-quality software projects

With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager, you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation.

You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web
  • Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas
  • Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance
  • Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs
  • Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach
  • Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence

  • Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau
  • Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results
  • Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality

What We Look For:

  • 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products.

  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment.
  • Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs.
  • Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization.

What We Offer You:

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

ABOUT US

At Heim, we are reinventing how healthcare is delivered.

We believe that healthcare is best delivered in the home of patients, and that we are at the cusp of a systemic shift away from hospital based care. Our mission is to expand access to in-person clinical care at home by empowering community nurses with technology that makes care delivery more efficient.

We have created an AI native ecosystem that optimises the complex scheduling involved in delivering community based care, and are on track to automate every non clinical touchpoint for nurses.

To date, our technology has powered our network of 400+ practitioners to deliver c. 30K appointments, and we have shown that our algorithms bring down the cost of at-home visits by c.35% whilst freeing up valuable time for care in doing so. We are growing fast and our ambitions are big – with new international markets on the roadmap, and strong investor backing.

Our aim is to create the most productive, AI-enabled distributed clinical workforce working at the intersection of public and private health.By joining Heim, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure that puts clinical care in the home.

WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT HEIM

We are reinventing how healthcare is delivered. Here are the things that shape your day-to-day:

  • Meaningful problems – we build systems that improve how organisations understand and care for people. The work is complex, applied, and grounded in real-world patient impact

  • High standards, low ego – you’ll work alongside thoughtful engineers, clinicians, and operators who care about clarity and good judgement

  • Speed with intent – we move quickly but deliberately. Clear ownership, evidence-based decisions, outcomes over output

  • Simple, elegant solutions – we have a strong bias towards code that is easy to reason about, hard to break, and built to outlast the sprint it was born in

  • Direct access to founders – you’ll have visibility into and input on the direction of the company

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a full-stack TypeScript role in the truest sense – you will own problems across the entire system, from UI to infrastructure. AI isn’t a feature here; it’s a first principle. We expect you to use agentic coding tools fluently (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and to be building your own views on where agentic workflows can meaningfully improve what we ship.

You’ll be working on systems where the stakes are real: scheduling errors affect patient care, data quality issues affect clinical decisions, and downtime has consequences. That context sharpens every technical choice you make.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design and build product features end-to-end across the Heim tech stack – owning them from first principles to production

  • Architect and implement AI-powered workflows: scheduling optimisation, practitioner dispatch, clinical data enrichment, and agentic referral automations that reduce manual touchpoints for nurses

  • Own the full lifecycle of features – from TypeScript frontend through to backend services, infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and testing – without relying on separate DevOps or QA teams to close the loop

  • Build and maintain the APIs, services, and data models that underpin clinical operations – with the reliability and auditability a regulated environment demands

  • Collaborate with our product and clinical ops teams to translate ambiguous real-world problems into working software

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality, and advocate clearly when the trade-off isn’t acceptable

  • Contribute to the architecture and infrastructure decisions that will shape the platform as we scale to NHS Trusts across the UK and into new markets

  • Leave the codebase better than you found it – improving performance, clarity, and resilience as part of everyday delivery

You won’t get perfectly specified tickets. You’ll be trusted to think, decide, and ship.

HOW WE WORK

  • Small team, fast loops, few layers – your decisions land fast and the feedback is real

  • We operate a hybrid team set up, and value high quality in person time so you must be able to commute to our central London office

  • Technical judgement is respected and expected – you’ll have a real voice in architectural decisions

  • Disagreement is normal. Good ideas win, not hierarchical ones

  • Strong bias toward execution: fewer meetings, clear ownership, and decisions grounded in evidence


WHO THIS IS FOR

You’re a senior full-stack engineer who acts like a founder. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You’re comfortable roaming an unfamiliar part of the codebase when something needs fixing, and you’ll ask sharp clarifying questions before committing to an approach.

You probably have:

  • 6+ years building and owning production software in fast-moving environments

  • Genuine full-stack capability – you’re not “mostly frontend” or “mostly backend”; you care about and can own the whole system

  • Proven ability to own the full delivery lifecycle: frontend, backend, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and testing – without handing off to separate DevOps or QA teams

  • Active, fluent use of AI coding tools – Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot – not as novelty, but as default workflow

  • Experience making data-sensitive engineering decisions: you instinctively ask about PII classification, schema flexibility, and audit requirements before you build

  • A track record of shipping under ambiguity – you’ve taken a vague ask, formed a point of view, and delivered something that worked

  • The judgement to know when to move fast and when to slow down

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience in regulated environments (healthcare, fintech, legal) and an understanding of what “good enough” looks like when data sensitivity is high

  • Background building agentic or multi-step AI workflows in production

  • A side project or personal tool built with AI – something that shows you’ve been hands-on with Cursor, Claude Code, or AI integrations outside of work

  • Familiarity with NHS data standards, FHIR, or community care systems

Infrastructure and cloud experience (GCP or equivalent) beyond the basics

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Account Executive (Accounts 1 billion+)
jobs.description:
Senior Strategic Account Executive (Accounts 1 billion+)

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Senior Strategic Account Executive, you own the development and growth of a portfolio of assigned strategic accounts within your designated region. You build and execute strategic sales plans, develop trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Rithum's value across complex client organizations. You are accountable for meeting or exceeding financial targets by leading consultative, value-based sales engagements and securing high-value, multi-year software and services agreements.

Rithum empowers employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to work smarter, move faster, and create scalable ways of working. In this role, you will use AI and data-driven insights to strengthen account strategy, identify opportunities, improve sales effectiveness, and deliver more relevant and impactful client engagement.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Growth

  • Develop and execute account plans aligned to client priorities, commerce strategies, and growth objectives.
  • Meet or exceed sales targets by identifying, developing, and closing software and services opportunities.
  • Expand Rithum’s footprint across client brands, business units, geographies, channels, marketplaces, and capabilities.
  • Build qualified pipeline by identifying whitespace and new opportunities within assigned accounts.

Executive & Value-Based Selling

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders.
  • Understand client priorities and position Rithum’s capabilities against business outcomes.
  • Lead consultative, value-based conversations and develop compelling business cases.
  • Navigate complex buying groups and build consensus across decision-makers.

Deal Execution

  • Lead complex sales opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Develop deal strategies that address client priorities, competitive dynamics, commercial considerations, and barriers to close.
  • Lead negotiations across pricing, terms, procurement, legal, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Apply the Rithum Way of Selling to opportunity strategy, qualification, progression, and close.

Pipeline, Forecasting & AI

  • Maintain a disciplined pipeline and deliver accurate, timely forecasts.
  • Maintain high-quality CRM data and use insights to prioritize accounts and opportunities.
  • Leverage AI and sales technologies to strengthen research, account planning, client engagement, and productivity.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional deal teams, bringing together the expertise needed to advance opportunities and deliver client value.
  • Partner across Client Success, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, and other teams as needed.
  • Share client, market, and competitive insights with Product and business leadership.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B software, SaaS, or technology sales experience
  • 5+ years in a closing role selling to strategic or enterprise accounts, or 2+ years selling Rithum solutions to enterprise clients, with quota attainment
  • Proven success in a full cycle quota carrying role; from strategic territory planning, prospecting, developing & closing complex 6 figure transactions (minimum 100k deal size)
  • Consistent recent quota attainment (100%+ for 4+ consecutive quarters) in a competitive, metrics-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated success developing and growing strategic accounts through new opportunities, expansion, cross-sell, upsell, or new use cases.
  • Experience leading complex sales cycles involving senior executives, multiple stakeholders, and commercial negotiations.
  • Mastery of structured, value-based sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, SPIN, Miller Heiman, Value Selling, Solution Selling) with evidence of pipeline progression and forecast accuracy, translating solutions into measurable business outcomes and leading cross-functional deal teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through self-generated outbound prospecting, with measurable activity standards (e.g., 40–60+ daily touchpoints)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop account plans, identify whitespace, build pipeline, and maintain accurate forecasts.
  • Disciplined use of CRM and sales tools (Salesforce preferred) and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, LinkedIn Navigator, ZoomInfo) for pipeline, activity, and conversion tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, data, and modern sales technologies to improve sales effectiveness.
  • Ability to operate independently and travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS, software, or technology sales experience.
  • Experience selling enterprise commerce, e-commerce, marketplace, retail technology, or related solutions.
  • Experience selling to large brands, retailers, manufacturers, or enterprises with complex buying environments.
  • Experience selling integrated solutions across multiple products, capabilities, or services.
  • Familiarity with partner- or channel-influenced sales motions.
  • Experience positioning data-driven or AI-powered solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Travel Required

Up to 25%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

Benefits

  • Enhanced Private Medical Insurance and a Health Cash Back Plan
  • Life insurance & disability benefits
  • Pension plan with 4% Company match
  • Competitive time off package with 25 Days of PTO, 9 Company-paid Holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 10 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days and 1 Paid Volunteer Day
  • £45/month Remote work stipend for internet
  • Access to tools to support your wellbeing such as the Calm App and an Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional development stipend and learning and development offerings to help you build the skills and connections you need to move forward in your career
  • Peer-to-peer recognition tool; earn points to redeem for gift cards, swag, and more
  • Charitable contribution match per team member

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Solutions Engineer

Help the world move AI.

At Kong, we're building the connectivity layer that brings AI, APIs, and applications together. Our work helps organizations innovate faster, more securely, and more efficiently.

We're looking for people who think boldly, lead with purpose, and want to make an impact. If you're ready to take on meaningful challenges, do work that matters, and help build what comes next for technology, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role:

Every company is racing to connect AI agents and LLMs to its APIs, data, and systems, securely and at scale. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and as a Staff Solutions Engineer you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers. You won’t just be selling a platform. You’ll be a trusted technical advisor, partnering with Account Executives to lead the technical sale with enterprise and strategic customers as they architect secure, scalable API ecosystems and move into the agentic AI era.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help customers understand the value of Kong’s API and AI connectivity platform, including AI Gateway, API Gateway, MCP, event streaming, and integration.

  • Shape how organizations connect AI agents and LLMs to their APIs, data, and business systems, with the right security, governance, cost control, and observability.

  • Run discovery conversations and map customer requirements to Kong solutions, through architecture design, demos, and proofs of concept, and into production.

  • Lead POCs and technical evaluations from start to finish, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Lead API management and AI governance evaluations, including scoping API and AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

  • Deliver demos of Kong’s API and AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including MCP governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

  • Run API- and AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and agentic architectures.

  • Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, from qualification through close.

  • Use AI to create impactful messaging, demos, and solutions tailored to each customer’s business.

  • Ensure customer success across your assigned accounts, onboarding new customers and identifying growth opportunities in existing ones.

  • Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

  • Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to advocate for customer needs, and synthesize customer feedback and market signals into actionable roadmap input.

  • Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementation, and services engagements.

  • Drive thought leadership through technical blogs, webinars, and speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, and API & AI Summit.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

  • A proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex (or equivalent).

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

  • A solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

  • Confidence presenting to and leading discussions with C-level and Director-level executives, product managers, architects, and engineers. You’re a strong listener who can tell the business story and go deep on the technology.

  • Enthusiasm for a high-profile, fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with API gateways, API integration, iPaaS, ETL, or microservices architectures.

  • Experience building with LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, or MCP servers, or working with AI platforms and model providers.

  • Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka.

  • Familiarity with the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

#LI-MP1

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.
