jobs.title: DTC Growth Strategist
jobs.description:
DTC Growth Strategist

DTC GROWTH STRATEGIST

A DTC Growth Strategist at CTC drives profitable growth for clients by translating raw financial data into precise marketing maneuvers. You will guide clients and teammates with clear financial models, diagnostic reviews, and actionable recommendations, ensuring every marketing dollar is understood through the lens of profit.

When results deviate from plan, you’ll take ownership in diagnosing the issue, adjusting forecasts, and optimizing within the meta account in order to restore profitable growth. Above all, you are the financial steward of your accounts—trusted to bring clarity, accuracy, and solutions that align business goals with sustainable outcomes.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

YOU SET THE STANDARD

  • You seek to define “best in class” across both growth strategy and media buying.
  • You arrive prepared with forecasts, insights, and clear next steps.
  • You approach challenge and failure with curiosity and resilience.
  • Your word is trustworthy — people know that if you are involved, it will get done.
  • Your word is trustworthy; you do what you say you will

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

  • You exist to turn marketing strategies into financial outcomes.
  • You’re excited by the complexities of a business and love identifying growth solutions.
  • You thrive at translating platform execution into contribution margin and growth targets.
  • You clearly articulate complex concepts in ways that clients and teammates can understand.
  • You are in the habit of documenting, reporting, and forecasting your work.

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

  • You inspire others with your expertise and strategic thinking.
  • You proactively share insights with your team and clients.
  • You embody humility (willing to do the work), ambition (vision for the future), and empathy (understanding what drives others).
  • You contribute learnings back into CTC’s systems and playbooks.
  • You balance strategy, execution, and communication to help others thrive.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

STRATEGY & FORECASTING

  • Build and maintain growth forecasts in Statlas.
  • Align forecasts with marketing calendars, launches, and contribution margin goals.
  • Translate forecasts into daily/weekly pacing to ensure spend and performance remain within targets.

MEDIA EXECUTION

  • Build, manage, and optimize campaigns across Meta, wile overseeing the management of Google, and YouTube (with expansion to TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat).
  • Lead creative diversification and media testing to profitably scale accounts.
  • Design and interpret incrementality tests (geo holdouts, conversion lift) and integrate results into iROAS modeling.
  • Troubleshoot campaigns quickly and pivot strategies when needed.

CLIENT COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING

  • Serve as the primary growth partner for your accounts.
  • Communicate forecasts, results, and recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Lead weekly updates, monthly reviews, and quarterly planning sessions.

COLLABORATION & CONTRIBUTION

  • Contribute your learnings back into CTC’s shared processes and tools.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, helping advance CTC’s Growth Engineer framework.

Note: Pixel and feed health are managed by a separate floating ops resource. This role is focused on strategy, execution, and client outcomes.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Holding a book of business above agreed upon revenue targets
  • Retaining clients while guiding clients toward profitable growth
  • Consistently deliver forecasts within ±5% accuracy.
  • Grow Contribution Margin quarter over quarter
  • Grow media spend quarter over quarter at or above iROAS thresholds.
  • Run and apply incrementality tests that shape client investment decisions.
  • Demonstrate clear link between execution and contribution margin outcomes.
  • Earn client trust through clear communication, preparedness, and results.
  • Embody CTC’s values — Set the Standard, Driven to Increase Value, Create an Environment of Excellence.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • 4–6 years in eCommerce growth marketing with direct account ownership.
  • Proven ability to manage $100K+/month in paid media spend.
  • Hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube; familiarity with TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat.
  • Experience designing and interpreting incrementality tests.
  • Strong analytical skills with fluency in contribution margin, iROAS, and financial modeling.
  • High EQ and communication skills: trusted advisor, clear storyteller, resilient problem solver.
  • Curiosity and adaptability: thrive in ambiguity, learn fast, and share knowledge generously.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • $120K - $150K base salary, annually
    • This is prior to any benefits (see the “ABOUT US” Section for additional details
  • Bonus Structure | $30K-$50K bonus tiers

ABOUT US

At CTC, we are fixated on building the next generation of legendary brands and the people who will lead them.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing this mission, we organize all of our decisions — from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money — in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone. They're challenging.

In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

For those who resonate with the following values, CTC has proven itself to be a remarkable place to grow and thrive.

  1. We Set the Standard
  2. We Are Driven To Increase Value
  3. We Create an Environment of Excellence

We’ll come alongside you and care for you in your pursuits by offering full-time permanent CTC employees:

  • 401K | program with a 3% company match (post 90 days employment) to bring out the investor inside you
  • TIME OFF | When you’re at CTC, you’re firing on all cylinders. To make that possible, we offer a Flexible Time Off policy where you will coordinate with supervisor to take time away from the office for rest, travel, and variety of others things that are important to you!
  • MEDICAL | Full health, dental, and vision benefits that fit your lifestyle and goals
  • WELLNESS | A wellness reimbursement program that inspires 360 degrees of health: mentally, physically, and spiritually

CTC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We Embrace I.D.E.A. and are committed to fostering a culture of performance and inclusivity.

Associate Account Executive

Associate Account Executive

The Associate Account Executive plays a key role in driving CTC’s growth by managing a portfolio of eCommerce brands and uncovering opportunities to expand each partnership. This individual builds strong, trust-based relationships with clients, ensuring seamless delivery while identifying ways to increase value through new initiatives and strategic recommendations. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates with clarity and confidence, and brings a proactive, sales-minded approach to growing revenue and strengthening long-term client relationships.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

YOU SET THE STANDARD

The Associate Account Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth within their existing book of business by identifying, developing, and closing opportunities that expand the client partnership. This role combines strategic account management with proactive sales execution ensuring each client realizes the full potential of CTC’s services while the Associate Account Executive meets or exceeds defined monthly and quarterly upsell targets. Success in this role is measured by the ability to deepen client engagement, increase total account value, and consistently uncover new ways for CTC to deliver measurable business impact. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Deliver on Revenue Accountability: Consistently meet or exceed upsell and renewal targets, contributing to both individual and company-wide revenue objectives.
  • Own the Upsell Pipeline: Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities across the assigned client portfolio, accurately forecasting revenue and tracking progress toward monthly and quarterly sales goals.
  • Identify Growth Opportunities: Analyze account performance, client objectives, and market trends to pinpoint where CTC’s additional offerings (such as new channels, creative solutions, or strategic programs) can drive incremental ROI.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (Channel Leaders, TikTok Shops, Strategy, Creative, and Email) to design and deliver data-driven proposals that align client growth goals with CTC’s service capabilities.
  • Lead Strategic Conversations: Communicate new strategies, present performance insights, and position upsell opportunities as natural extensions of client success.
  • Proposal & Contract Ownership: Prepares accurate proposals, scopes, and contracts that align client needs with CTC’s services and internal guidelines.

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

The Associate Account Executive is responsible for developing deep, trust-based relationships with key client stakeholders, positioning CTC as an indispensable strategic partner in their growth journey. This role requires a balance of relational intelligence and business acumen, ensuring that every client interaction builds confidence, drives clarity, and reinforces CTC’s commitment to delivering measurable results. Success in this area means maintaining proactive communication, anticipating client needs, and collaborating cross-functionally to resolve challenges with speed and professionalism. The Associate Account Executive will:

  • Maintain a Client First Approach: Act as a trusted advisor and advocate, ensuring every upsell initiative strengthens the client’s overall results, satisfaction, and long-term partnership value.
  • Anticipate and Address Needs: Maintain a pulse on client goals, concerns, and market dynamics to identify risks early and provide proactive solutions before issues escalate.
  • Collaborate to Solve Challenges: Work closely with internal teams (including Strategy, Creative, Email, and Operations) to troubleshoot and resolve client challenges swiftly, ensuring alignment between client priorities and internal execution.
  • Integrate AI into Daily Workflow: Use AI tools to improve preparation, uncover account insights, and work more efficiently while demonstrating curiosity, accountability, and the ability to adapt quickly.

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

The Associate Account Executive sets the tone for operational excellence across every client engagement, ensuring that communication, execution, and collaboration meet the highest professional standards. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform)
jobs.description:
Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform)

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform) will design, build and operate the data platform that makes UFORCE’s operational data usable for AI model training and validation.

You will connect diverse data sources—from high-frequency telemetry and time series to imagery, video, documents and structured records—and make the resulting data discoverable, governed and reproducible. You will work hands-on across architecture, pipelines, data quality and platform operations, while helping other engineers and partner teams make sound technical decisions.

This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with a practical approach to delivery. You will partner with ML, product, engineering, field and security teams to build a platform that works for real use cases and operating constraints. Model research and model performance decisions remain with the accountable ML and product owners.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver a data platform for ingesting, storing, discovering and preparing heterogeneous data for approved analytics and ML workflows.

  • Build reliable batch and streaming pipelines for priority data sources, with validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills, replay and appropriate handling of failed data.

  • Preserve the context needed to understand and trace data, including timestamps, source identity, format versions and provenance where available.

  • Establish data contracts, metadata, interfaces and ownership boundaries that make data easier to find, understand and use across teams.

  • Enable reproducible training and evaluation datasets, including source and transformation versions, labels, filters and split definitions.

  • Build data-quality checks for issues such as missing data, corruption, duplication and temporal misalignment. Work with ML partners to surface coverage, sampling and leakage risks.

  • Make data rights, classification, retention, permitted use and access restrictions visible and actionable.

  • Design for the environments the work requires, which may include cloud, on-premises, sovereign or disconnected deployments.

  • Instrument and operate data workflows with clear visibility into health, freshness, quality, throughput and cost. Document failure handling, recovery and operational ownership.

  • Apply appropriate access controls, encryption, auditability and data-handling practices in partnership with security and other stakeholders.

  • Lead technical decisions across teams, communicate trade-offs and risks, mentor engineers, and deliver reusable components in small, reviewable increments.

What success looks like

  • A coherent platform architecture and incremental roadmap support priority AI and product use cases, with clear interfaces and ownership.

  • Priority data sources are ingested reliably and traceably, with agreed measures for completeness, freshness, quality and recovery.

  • Approved datasets are discoverable, governed and reproducible from source data through transformations to training and evaluation outputs.

  • ML teams can assess data quality, provenance and known limitations before using a dataset, and issues can be traced back and corrected.

  • Platform workflows have actionable monitoring, documented recovery procedures and clear operational ownership.

  • Security, deployment and cost constraints are understood and incorporated into platform decisions.

  • Partner teams can use the platform effectively, and engineers are unblocked through clear designs, reusable tools and mentoring.

Success measures and numerical targets will be established with the hiring manager and partner teams once baselines and operating constraints are understood.

Required qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering or a related field.

  • Data platform experience — designed, built and operated production data platforms or data-intensive systems end to end.

  • Staff-level technical leadership — led architectural decisions and cross-team delivery, mentored engineers and communicated clearly with stakeholders.

  • Hands-on engineering — strong Python and SQL skills, or equivalent, with experience in testing, code review and production-quality software.

  • Data pipelines — built reliable batch and streaming pipelines, including validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills and replay.

  • Data modalities — worked with structured or semi-structured data and at least one relevant modality, such as telemetry, time series, imagery, video or documents; understands provenance and temporal alignment.

  • ML data foundations — experience with storage, cataloguing, lineage, quality controls and reproducible datasets, including versioning, splits and leakage or sampling risks.

  • Platform operations — experience with observability, incident response, recovery, reliability and cost management.

  • Security and governance — practical knowledge of access controls, encryption, auditability, retention and sensitive-data handling.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with robotics, connected-device fleets or other operational systems that produce high-frequency or multimodal data.

  • Experience designing data systems for constrained connectivity, offline, air-gapped or sovereign environments.

  • Experience supporting defence, regulated or other security-sensitive customers.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Commercial Learning and Development
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Commercial Learning and Development

At Elation, our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life. We are a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform on a mission to enable every patient to receive the highest quality of care. Since inception, we’ve been focused on building a delightful, world‑class customer experience that empowers physicians to focus on delivering phenomenal care to patients.

Elation Health is looking for a Senior Manager, Training & Enablement to build and lead a dedicated function that strengthens how our employees and customers learn.

As Elation grows, we’re investing in a coordinated, scalable approach to training and education. You’ll lead a small, nimble team and own internal learning programs for Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Onboarding, Support, and other teams. You’ll also set the direction for customer education, partnering with customer-facing leaders to develop programs for new and existing customers.

This is a hands-on leadership role with the opportunity to shape the function’s strategy, programs, and ways of working. You’ll coach your team while staying directly involved in curriculum development, content creation, and training delivery.

This role reports to the Director of Product and Customer Marketing and works closely with leaders and subject matter experts across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Build and lead the function

  • Establish a training and enablement strategy aligned with company goals and functional priorities.
  • Lead needs analysis: identify performance gaps, determine where training will have the biggest impact, and prioritize from that analysis rather than primarily responding to requests for courses.
  • Evaluate existing programs and resources, identify opportunities to strengthen them, and develop a roadmap for growth.
  • Manage and develop a small team, setting clear priorities, responsibilities, and quality standards.
  • Establish consistent processes for training requests, program development, and content maintenance.

Develop and deliver internal learning programs

  • Own role-based onboarding and ongoing training for customer-facing teams, adapting content to each audience’s responsibilities.
  • Collaborate with commercial leaders to develop training that supports their commercial strategy and priorities.
  • Design and facilitate live and on-demand learning covering products, workflows, launches, and role-specific skills.
  • Partner with functional leaders and subject matter experts to translate complex information into clear, actionable instruction.
  • Reinforce learning after the session through hands-on practice, job aids, manager coaching resources, and train-the-trainer programs so new skills hold up on the job.

Expand customer education

  • Support the customer education strategy and roadmap, in partnership with the teams that deliver customer onboarding and training today, so priorities are clear and content is not duplicated.
  • Build a mix of live sessions and self-guided content tailored to different customer roles and experience levels, and set the standard for how customer education content is produced and kept current.
  • Use customer questions and feedback to keep education relevant as our products and customers’ needs evolve.

Improve how we work and measure success

  • Use AI to accelerate content development and program maintenance while maintaining accuracy and quality.
  • Develop tools and workflows that make learning resources easy to find, use, and keep current.
  • Measure behavior change, not just completion. Use learner feedback, assessments, on-the-job application, and business outcomes to show where learning is changing how people work and where it is not.

Priorities for the First 6-12 Months

This role spans strategy, people management, content development, and customer education. In the first year, the emphasis is on:

  • Establish a needs-driven approach. Assess existing programs and requests across customer-facing teams, identify the biggest performance gaps, and set priorities from that analysis rather than from the queue of course requests.
  • Rebuild onboarding for priority roles. Focus first on the highest-volume customer-facing roles, with practice, reinforcement, and manager coaching built in from the start.
  • Stand up the function. Build and develop the team, define how training requests are triaged and prioritized, and set quality and maintenance standards for content.
  • Set the customer education direction. Agree with customer-facing leaders on what this role owns versus what stays with the teams delivering customer education today, and build the roadmap from there.
  • Establish measurement. Define how we will track behavior change and business outcomes so we can show impact within the first year.

What We’re Looking For / Professional Qualifications

  • Training and enablement experience. 7+ years of experience in training, learning and development, enablement, or a related field, including 2+ years managing and developing a team. You’re willing to contribute directly to content creation and delivery.
  • Experience across customer-facing and commercial teams. A track record of developing and leading training for multiple functions, such as Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Onboarding, and Support.
  • Healthcare technology experience. Experience working in healthcare SaaS or healthcare technology.
  • Needs analysis and performance consulting. You start with the performance gap, not the course request, and you can show how you decided where training would have the biggest impact.
  • Demonstrated learning design expertise. You can structure effective learning experiences, engage different audiences, and help people apply what they learn on the job. A formal instructional design background is not required, but proven learning design work is.
  • A builder’s mindset. You’ve launched or significantly expanded programs or functions, translating business needs into practical solutions that scale.
  • Cross-functional influence. You build trusted relationships, draw on subject matter expertise, and align stakeholders around shared priorities.
  • Practical AI fluency. You have experience using AI in your work and can assess where it adds value and where human judgment is essential.
  • Adaptability and initiative. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, anticipating needs, and adjusting plans as new opportunities emerge.

Nice to Have

  • Formal training or certification in instructional design or adult learning.
  • Experience developing external customer education programs.
  • Experience with EHR and revenue cycle management (RCM) technology.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems and content authoring tools, and revenue intelligence platforms such as Gong.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Builder and entrepreneurial mindset

You're comfortable defining a new role. You don't need a playbook handed to you. You can create processes, build programs, and establish best practices in a fast-paced environment where things are still taking shape.

Quick learner and problem solver

Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

What You'll Do

  • Website, personalization and SEO: Own performance on our marketing sites, including landing pages, forms and conversion paths. Create personalized experiences using the latest tools. Own GA4 and GTM tracking and run A/B tests to lift conversion. Implement SEO and AI search strategies and decide which pages we need to build next.

  • Email and nurture, moving people toward sales: Build nurture paths mapped to each stage from lead to opportunity with a clear next step. Segment by role, company fit and intent so engineers, platform leads and execs each get the right message. Partner with Sales and RevOps on what sales-ready looks like, keep a regular drumbeat for people who aren’t ready yet, and write the emails yourself. Success is measured by meetings booked and pipeline, not opens and clicks.

This role is based in London or Stockholm.

Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â 
Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. Weâre empowering organizations to secure their softwareâno matter how the code is written!

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions.   • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

You will be a customer-facing program manager for large, complex AI infrastructure programs that run for many months and involve many teams across Vultr, as well as partners and suppliers. You will be the customer's primary point of contact for delivery, represent their priorities inside Vultr, and make sure what we commit to deliver is what they receive. The engineering and operations teams own and run their work; you connect it into a single delivery view for the customer and keep it moving. You will also lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how Vultr operates.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader with a record of delivering large infrastructure programs for demanding enterprise customers, who earns the trust of executives and engineers alike. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require sound judgment under pressure, candid communication when plans change, and the ability to lead teams you don't manage. You'll work on some of the largest AI infrastructure programs Vultr has ever taken on, in close partnership with senior leadership. Service Delivery is a new function at Vultr, so you will also help shape how it works. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery for one to two concurrent strategic customer programs, from the late stages of the sale through go-live and stable operation.

  • Own the customer relationship for delivery as primary contact and accountable owner, running executive governance such as steering committees, regular delivery reviews and escalations.

  • Partner with sales and account management before contract signature to confirm that what we commit to is deliverable, then make sure every commitment is tracked and met.

  • Coordinate the work of multiple engineering, infrastructure and operations teams, each with its own program managers, without taking over their plans: understand the dependencies between them, spot risks early and drive resolution.

  • Advocate for the customer inside Vultr, making sure their priorities shape decisions and challenging delays that can be avoided.

  • Communicate schedule changes to customers early and honestly, and lead difficult conversations about dates and scope with customer executives.

  • Manage each customer's path, from sales to delivery to ongoing support, leading formal customer acceptance once the service is live, ensuring nothing promised to the customer is lost along the way.

  • Lead cross-functional internal initiatives that improve how Vultr serves its customers, from planning through to a measurable outcome.

  • Coach Service Delivery Managers and build the methods, templates and standards the team uses.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 5 years managing customer-facing delivery of large, complex technology programs in cloud, data center, HPC, AI or telecommunications.

  • Proven ability to lead through influence across engineering, operations and commercial teams you don't manage.

  • Executive presence, including experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with senior customer stakeholders.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure delivery (data centers, networking, servers and GPUs, storage), enough to ask engineers the right questions and judge the answers.

  • Sound judgment under pressure, with a habit of raising risks early and bringing options rather than waiting for problems to escalate.

  • Experience moving customers from project delivery into ongoing operations and support.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, from detailed working sessions to executive summaries.

  • Proficiency with Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence and Salesforce, or similar program management, collaboration and CRM tools.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% to customer sites and data centers.

  • Flexibility to work extended hours, including some weekends, around major customer launches and across customer time zones.

  • Preferred: PMP, PgMP or equivalent certification; experience building a new delivery function or practice.

Compensation

$150,000 - $160,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and Indiaâs Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

Partner Solution Architect, Partner Center of Excellence
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloftâs certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that âEX = CXâ: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Â 

Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform.

As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.

You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.

Â 

Job Responsibilities

What you'll do

Guide Partners to Go-live

Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live. Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities. Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.

Own the Technical Escalation Path

Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects. Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira. Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room. Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.

Enable the Ecosystem

Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams. Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access. Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.

Build the Playbook

Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides. Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers. Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster. Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls. Product and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap. A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides. Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff. Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered. Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

What you'll bring

5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery. Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud). Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record. Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike. Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders. Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support. Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations. A builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process.

Preferred Qualifications

Nice to have

Integration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi. Background in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus. Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners. Exposure to ISV/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations. Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners.

All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Creative Director
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a Creative Director to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

What You'll Own

The creative standard

  • Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
  • Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
  • By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

A brand system that morphs

  • Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
  • Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

The team

  • Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
  • Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

Predictable, well-run delivery

  • Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
  • Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
  • Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

How You'll Work

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.
  • A portfolio of luxury or premium brand work that spans web, brand, and motion.

Leadership and mindset

  • Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
  • The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
  • Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
  • Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

Technical foundation

  • Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.
  • Strong process and operational habits for intake, prioritization, and review.

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate
Â 
The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
Â 
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
Â 
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
Â 
More than 20,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
Â 
Luxury Presence has earned a spot on BuiltInâs Best Places to Work list every year since 2020. Our founder and CEO was named a 2024 HousingWire Tech Trendsetter, and weâve won multiple Tech100 Awards. Inman has also honored us twice: with the 2025 Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform and the 2026 title of Best Proptech Company.
Â 
Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director (Network Testing & Planning) based in the United Kingdom.

We are seeking an experienced Account Director to drive revenue growth and expand strategic customer relationships across the UK, Ireland, and selected major European accounts. In this senior commercial role, you will lead sales strategy and business development for a portfolio of mobile network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions. You will be responsible for growing existing accounts, securing new customers, and building a sustainable pipeline across the telecommunications ecosystem. Working closely with technical, marketing, product, and sales teams, you will develop compelling value propositions and deliver solutions that address complex customer challenges. You will engage with mobile network operators, service providers, infrastructure companies, and other key industry stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity to influence the evolution of next-generation networks, including 5G, IoT, and emerging connectivity technologies, within a collaborative and globally distributed environment.

Accountabilities:

Take full ownership of territory revenue targets, sales pipeline development, and forecasting across the UK, Ireland, and assigned strategic European accounts. Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans aligned with business growth objectives and commercial priorities. Expand existing strategic customer relationships through account penetration, upselling, cross-selling, and the development of new business opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with senior commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders within target accounts. Work closely with Inside Sales and Demand Generation teams to identify target accounts, generate qualified leads, build pipeline, and accelerate sales opportunities. Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clear visibility of opportunity status, pipeline coverage, customer engagement, next steps, and revenue forecasts. Apply disciplined sales methodologies and opportunity qualification processes to ensure predictable growth and consistent commercial performance. Strengthen customer and partner relationships to generate repeat business, increase engagement value, and establish sustainable revenue streams.

Requirements:

Demonstrated success in B2B technology sales, with a proven track record of managing and achieving revenue targets and sales quotas. Significant experience selling to telecommunications operators, network equipment vendors, or organisations operating within the broader mobile network ecosystem. Strong understanding of mobile network technologies and the processes involved in planning, deploying, testing, optimising, and operating mobile networks. Proven ability to develop existing strategic accounts while successfully identifying and acquiring new customers. Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders. Excellent account planning, business development, opportunity qualification, negotiation, and closing capabilities. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to build compelling business cases, demonstrating measurable customer value beyond product features or pricing. Experience working closely with technical presales and solution engineering teams while maintaining ownership of commercial strategy and sales outcomes. Strong pipeline management, revenue forecasting, CRM discipline, and sales performance reporting skills. Ability to work autonomously across a geographically distributed territory while collaborating effectively within an international organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers and build trusted customer relationships. Previous experience in network testing, drive testing, network planning, RF optimisation, network performance, or related telecommunications software and solutions would be a significant advantage. Experience gained within telecom software providers, network equipment manufacturers, test and measurement companies, engineering consultancies, service organisations, or technology suppliers serving mobile network operators is particularly relevant. Knowledge of the competitive landscape for network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions would be highly desirable. A proactive, results-oriented, and entrepreneurial mindset, with strong relationship-building skills and the ability to identify and pursue new commercial opportunities.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation package and benefits. Fully remote working arrangement within the UK. Flexible working hours and adaptable working locations. Inclusive and collaborative international working environment that values diverse perspectives. Opportunities to contribute to innovative technologies shaping next-generation telecommunications networks. Career development opportunities and structured professional growth plans. Access to a global network of experienced professionals across multiple countries and technical disciplines. Commitment to sustainability through environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives. A workplace culture built around transparency, innovation, integrity, collaboration, and employee well-being. Manager, Account Managment
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloftâs certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that âEX = CXâ: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

The Manager, Account Management leads the Enterprise Account Management team responsible for growing customer relationships, expanding revenue, supporting retention, and delivering sustained customer value across Enterprise accounts. This role translates the Account Management strategy into consistent team execution and is accountable for performance against expansion ARR, pipeline creation, forecast accuracy, renewal execution, retention, and responsible consumption growth objectives.

The Manager provides hands-on leadership, coaching, and development to Enterprise Account Managers while creating clear expectations and accountability for results. They maintain visibility into customer portfolios, renewal posture, customer health, commercial opportunities, and token-consumption trends, helping Account Managers navigate complex situations, advance expansion opportunities, and mitigate revenue risk.

Working closely with Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and other cross-functional partners, the Manager helps ensure coordinated customer engagement and effective execution of account growth strategies. They use customer, pipeline, consumption, and performance data to identify trends, diagnose gaps, and determine where intervention is needed.

Strong performance in this role is reflected in predictable revenue outcomes, healthy expansion pipeline, effective retention and renewal execution, responsible consumption growth, strong customer relationships, and a high-performing Enterprise Account Management team.

Job Responsibilities

Revenue Growth & Account Performance

Own team performance against expansion ARR, upsell/cross-sell, token consumption growth, retention, renewal, and other applicable revenue objectives. Translate Account Management strategies established by senior leadership into clear Enterprise AM team priorities, operating rhythms, and execution plans. Coach Enterprise Account Managers on identifying, developing, and advancing expansion opportunities that increase customer value, SaaS revenue, and responsible AI/token consumption. Provide leadership and judgment on complex, high-value, or at-risk Enterprise customer opportunities and determine when additional resources or escalation are required. IdentifyÂ portfolioÂ trends,Â customerÂ needs,Â productÂ usageÂ patterns,Â consumptionÂ signals,Â andÂ commercialÂ insightsÂ andÂ surfaceÂ recommendationsÂ toÂ AccountÂ ManagementÂ leadership.

Pipeline,Â ForecastingÂ &Â PerformanceÂ Management

MaintainÂ accountabilityÂ forÂ expansionÂ pipelineÂ health,Â opportunityÂ progression,Â renewalÂ posture,Â forecastÂ quality,Â andÂ forecastÂ accuracyÂ acrossÂ theÂ team. Establish operating rhythms to inspect pipeline, customer portfolios, renewal risk, consumption trends, performance metrics, and progress against goals. Use CRM, Clari / SalesLoft, customer, consumption, and performance data to identify opportunities, risks, and performance gaps and drive appropriate action. Provide leadership with timely, data-informed visibility into expected results, renewal risk, expansion path, consumption trends, and emerging portfolio themes.

PeopleÂ LeadershipÂ &Â Development

Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Enterprise Account Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer value, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement. SetÂ clearÂ individualÂ andÂ teamÂ expectationsÂ andÂ manageÂ performanceÂ againstÂ definedÂ goals,Â customerÂ outcomes,Â andÂ revenueÂ objectives. Conduct regular 1:1s and team meetings focused on performance, coaching, development, account strategy, customer outcomes, and business priorities. Coach Account Managers to strengthen commercial judgment, customer engagement, MEDDPICC discipline, negotiation, opportunity management, consumption fluency, and account strategy. Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain high-performing Enterprise Account Management talent and support meaningful career development.

CustomerÂ &Â Cross-FunctionalÂ Leadership

Build strong working relationships across Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and other teams supporting the customer lifecycle. Ensure Account Managers effectively coordinate internal resources around expansion opportunities, renewals, retention risks, AI/token-consumption opportunities, and complex customer needs. Support executive-level or complex Enterprise customer conversations when leadership involvement can improve customer or commercial outcomes. Identify recurring friction points across the customer lifecycle and partner cross-functionally to improve processes, customer experience, and AM execution.

OperationalÂ ExcellenceÂ &Â ContinuousÂ Improvement

Evaluate team workflows, performance patterns, and operating practices to identify opportunities for greater effectiveness, consistency, and scalability across the Enterprise AM motion. ReinforceÂ disciplinedÂ useÂ ofÂ CRM,Â ClariÂ /Â SalesLoft,Â andÂ otherÂ AccountÂ ManagementÂ systemsÂ toÂ maintainÂ accurateÂ customer,Â pipeline,Â consumption,Â renewal,Â andÂ forecastingÂ information. Share customer, consumption, and team insights with senior leadership to inform Account Management priorities, processes, enablement, and strategy. Support adoption of approved tools, processes, and operating practices that improve Enterprise Account Manager effectiveness. OtherÂ dutiesÂ asÂ assigned.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in account management, customer expansion, sales, or a related customer-facing commercial function, including experience demonstrating success against renewal, retention, expansion, and revenue objectives. 2+ years of experience directly managing and developing customer-facing or commercial professionals, preferably Account Managers serving Enterprise customers. Demonstrated success managing expansion pipeline, forecasting, renewals, retention, upsell/cross-sell performance, and usage-based or consumption-oriented growth motions. Strong coaching and people-management skills, including setting expectations, developing talent, managing performance, inspecting account strategy, and building accountable teams. Strong commercial judgment with the ability to assess customer opportunities, renewal risk, consumption potential, revenue risks, and complex account situations. ExcellentÂ communication,Â negotiation,Â relationship-building,Â coaching,Â andÂ executiveÂ presence. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate customer, consumption, pipeline, and performance data into action. Experience using CRM, Clari / SalesLoft, and related systems to manage customer portfolios, pipeline, forecasting, renewal posture, and performance. jobs.title: Senior Energy Markets Analyst, PJM
jobs.description:
Senior Energy Markets Analyst, PJM

Voltus runs demand response programs across North American wholesale markets and utilities. As the Senior Energy Markets Analyst for PJM, you will own our PJM utility programs end to end. You will run one established utility program and help launch a second, newer one. You will also support Product and Partnerships in sizing and designing the next set of PJM utility programs, where much of our future revenue and margin sits.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will manage your own work, with your manager setting priorities and reviewing results rather than directing day-to-day tasks. For each program you own, you will be the go-to expert inside Voltus and the main contact for the utility.

What you will do

Run our PJM utility programs end to end: registrations, nominations, dispatch, performance calculations and settlements.

Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships.

Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings.

Explain program rules in plain language to Sales, customers and Dispatch Ops, and write to utilities and PJM on registration and settlement issues.

Support PJM - ELRP (Load Management) registrations starting in 2028.

Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports.

What success looks like

Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement.

Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does.

New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target.

Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch.

A written playbook for the new program exists that someone else could pick up.

Product, Partnerships, Dispatch Ops and utility contacts come to you directly.

Your analysis has informed a program design discussion with Product and Partnerships.

What you bring

Required

3 to 5 years of hands-on energy markets experience in demand response or a closely related area (registrations, performance calculations, settlements), in any ISO or utility program.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, baseline-versus-metered-load calculations, and settlement reconciliations that others can audit.

Basic SQL: read-only queries with joins, aggregations and filters to pull site, interval and dispatch data.

Basic Python, with familiarity with Pandas, to process interval data across many sites and automate repetitive registration and settlement prep.

Clear written communication, including plain-language explanations of program rules and professional correspondence with utilities and ISOs.

Ownership: you make judgment calls on ambiguous program rules, know when to escalate, and build process where none exists.

Availability during core Eastern hours and during test and event windows. PJM, the utilities and all program deadlines run on Eastern time.

Preferred

PJM experience, in this order of relevance: DR programs (ELRP, utility DR programs in PJM states); settlements and performance calculations; capacity market basics (PLCs, nominations, delivery year calendar); wholesale market operations.

Strong DR candidates from ERCOT, NYISO or MISO are encouraged to apply.Â 

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).

Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.

At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app.

Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams.

Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally.

Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus!

Experience with Xcode build performance, Swift Package Manager or Bazel/Tuist, and CI/CD for iOS at scale.
